item.title: Shares stumble, oil rises as investors await AI sector earnings
item.description: Asian stocks retreated broadly on Tuesday while oil prices rose as geopolitical risks rattled sentiment ahead of key results from AI bellwether companies.
item.dc:creator: Rocky Swift
item.content:encoded: Asian stocks retreated broadly on Tuesday while oil prices rose as geopolitical risks rattled sentiment ahead of key results from AI bellwether companies. The euro recouped some losses from the previous session that were spurred by escalating riots in France. Crude prices resumed their climb as markets weighed an executive order from US President Donald Trump that waived some sanctions and tariffs on Russian energy. The spotlight is on corporate earnings, with investors seeking fresh evidence that consumers and the broader economy remain resilient. Quarterly earnings are due from SpaceX and Netflix on Tuesday, with results from AI heavyweights such as Meta (META.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) scheduled for later in the week. "The market is happy to cover shorts and unwind defensive trades, but that's very different from having the conviction to rebuild aggressive exposure to AI," Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone, said in a note. "French sovereign risk is clearly being priced into European equities, but the euro's resilience suggests traders aren't yet treating it as a systemic European problem." The MSCI Asia ex-Japan index (.MISX00000PUS) fell 1.14%, while Japan's Nikkei 225 (.N225) dropped 0.98%. South Korea’s KOSPI (.KS11) tumbled 3.92%. In early European trade, the pan-region Euro Stoxx 50 futures slipped 0.57%, German DAX futures dipped 0.33% and FTSE futures lost 0.47%. US stock futures, the S&P 500 e-minis , rose 0.12% to 7,743.5. The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, fell 0.16% to 101.80, with the euro up 0.17% at $1.1229. The Japanese yen strengthened 0.16% to 158.24 per dollar, and sterling rose 0.21% to $1.3327. Overnight, French authorities set [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"curfews"] in parts of several cities including Paris, Lille and Nice, after a weekend of riots and looting stemming from nationwide anti-government protests. And in the Middle East, dozens were killed and more than 200 were injured after an [USN:L1N46509O TEXT:"attack"] by the Iran-aligned Houthis on a government security forces training camp in Yemen's Shabwa province. EARNINGS AND AI MAJORS IN FOCUS Netflix is expected to report slowing revenue growth in the third quarter, while SpaceX is forecast to report $12.74 billion in quarterly revenue. General Motors (GM.N) , Hasbro (HAS.O) , Halliburton (HAL.N) , and 3M (MMM.N) are among the more established names due to report on Tuesday. Along with quarterly results, markets are increasingly focused on the massive spending plans of the major AI players. Facebook operator Meta is one of five AI hyperscalers expected to increase combined capital expenditure to about $1.2 trillion next year, according to Goldman Sachs. "Investors are fine with AI being used more. What they're questioning is whether every dollar of AI capex earns more than it costs to finance," said Ninghui Liu, head of investment strategy and research for APAC at State Street Investment Management. "AI has gone from an earnings story to a balance-sheet story, and now a unit-economics story to some extent." Shares in South Korean AI infrastructure company Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) plunged nearly 30% below their initial public offering price in their market [USN:L1N466008 TEXT:"debut"], after the firm raised 201.1 billion won ($151.12 million) in an IPO. US crude rose 0.18% to $103.85 a barrel and Brent rose to $109.64 per barrel, up 0.08% on the day. Spot gold rose 0.13% to $4,145.25 an ounce. An executive [USN:L4N46600B TEXT:"order"] issued by Trump on Friday night waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs, including duties on the country's goods and penalties for buying its oil and gas. However, Trump said on Saturday he has yet to announce a final decision on the matter. Inflationary pressures from elevated oil prices have put most major central banks on a tightening bias, though with a careful eye on whether economies are resilient enough to absorb higher interest rates. Recent comments from Federal Reserve officials, including Chair Kevin Warsh, suggest policymakers are in no rush to hike rates again. The US Census Bureau is due to release September figures, with housing starts expected to rise to 1.305 million from 1.275 million in August, while building permits are seen at 1.395 million compared with 1.403 million. European Central Bank policymaker Martin Kocher is due to speak later on Tuesday, as well as ECB policymaker and Finnish central bank governor Olli Rehn. Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee member Megan Greene will deliver a speech at the London School of Economics. In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin gained 0.22% to $82,117.01, and ether rose 0.63% to $2,413.64.

item.title: Micron union in Taiwan to launch strike as bonus dispute escalates
item.description: A union representing Micron Technology workers in Taoyuan, Taiwan, said it would launch a strike on Thursday to coincide with a mediation meeting between the US chipmaker and another collective representing workers at its Taichung operations, escalating a dispute over employee bonuses.
item.dc:creator: Wen-Yee Lee
item.content:encoded: A union representing Micron Technology (MU.O) workers in Taoyuan, Taiwan, said it would launch a strike on Thursday to coincide with a mediation meeting between the US chipmaker and another collective representing workers at its Taichung operations, escalating a dispute over employee bonuses. The strike raises the stakes in a labour dispute at one of Micron's most important manufacturing hubs, where it produces DRAM and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips, key components in AI servers. The Taoyuan union said the strike was intended to show solidarity with the Taichung union and to increase pressure on Micron to put forward a concrete profit-sharing proposal. Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan, with separate unions representing workers at its Taoyuan and Taichung operations. The company has said it has invested more than T$1.6 trillion ($49 billion) on the island. Mediation between Micron and the Taoyuan union ended without an agreement in September. The union [USN:L6N45T0D9 TEXT:"secured authorisation"] from its members to strike in early October. The Taichung union, which represents workers at Micron's largest operation in Taiwan, remains in negotiations with the company. It has yet to hold a vote on whether to strike. The Taoyuan union did not specify how long the solidarity strike would last, saying it would release further details on Thursday. "Through our actions, we will make our dissatisfaction with the current system heard and demonstrate our determination to establish a fair profit-sharing system," the Taoyuan union said in a statement on Monday. Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te [USN:L1N461063 TEXT:"called last week"] for Micron and its workers to negotiate "sincerely". ($1 = 32.4940 Taiwan dollars)

item.title: China's September US soybean imports rebound from zero a year earlier, data shows
item.description: China imported 360,878 metric tons of US soybeans in September, up from zero a year earlier, as soybeans bought under a deal to end last year's trade war continued to arrive at Chinese ports.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China imported 360,878 metric tons of US soybeans in September, up from [USN:L2N3W102Q TEXT:"zero"] a year earlier, as soybeans bought under a deal to end last year's trade war continued to arrive at Chinese ports. Imports from Brazil fell 2.4% year-on-year to 10.7 million tons from 10.96 million tons in September last year, data from the General Administration of Customs showed on Tuesday China, the world's largest soybean buyer, [USN:L4N46007U TEXT:"brought in"] 11.88 million metric tons of soybeans in September, down 7.7% from the same month last year In the January-September period, soybean imports from the US fell 34% from a year earlier to 11.06 million tons, while shipments from Brazil rose 3.4% to 65.84 million tons Trade tensions between Beijing and Washington last year had prompted Chinese buyers to delay purchases of the previous US harvest until after an October summit between the two countries' leaders Following the meeting, Beijing [USN:L4N3YL08R TEXT:"purchased"] around 12 million tons of US soybeans, still well below levels from before the trade war China had also [USN:L1N4610ML TEXT:"purchased"] more than 60% of its 25-million-ton US soybean buying target for the 2026/27 marketing year, with shipments beginning in September, traders told Reuters last week

item.title: Activist investor Starboard builds stake in Solstice, urges focus on core business, FT reports
item.description: Activist investor Starboard Value has built a stake in Solstice Advanced Materials and is pushing the Honeywell spin-off to take steps to lift its share price, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Activist investor Starboard Value has built a stake in Solstice Advanced Materials (SOLS.O) and is pushing the Honeywell spin-off to take steps to lift its share price, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter. Starboard wants US speciality chemicals group Solstice to focus on execution in its core refrigerants and nuclear businesses and cut roughly $100 million in corporate overhead, the report said Starboard CEO Jeff Smith is expected to unveil the investment on Tuesday at the 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit, the report said Solstice and Starboard could not immediately be reached for comment outside regular business hours Solstice, which was spun off from Honeywell (HON.O) last year, makes specialty chemicals and materials used in industries, including semiconductor, refrigeration, nuclear power and healthcare The report comes months after Solstice and Element Solutions [USN:L4N44O21D TEXT:"scrapped"] their proposed $14.5 billion merger, citing shareholder feedback supporting the companies' standalone strategies Solstice shares nearly doubled in the months following its spin-off last October, but have since retreated sharply after the collapse of its proposed merger with Element Solutions, falling about 33% from a peak reached in May The stock is still up about 25% this year, valuing the company at $9.6 billion as of Monday's close

item.title: Rangers thrash Ducks, reach 6-0-0 at home for first time in 36 years
item.description: Rookie Dylan Garand made 29 saves, Oliver Bjorkstrand scored twice and the New York Rangers remained unbeaten at home with a 5-2 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Rookie Dylan Garand made 29 saves, Oliver Bjorkstrand scored twice and the New York Rangers remained unbeaten at home with a 5-2 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Monday night. The Rangers stopped their first losing streak of the opening weeks (0-1-1) and improved to 6-0-0 at home. New York has won its first six home games for the third time in team history and the first time since opening the 1990-91 season with a club-record eight straight home wins. Sean Durzi scored 1:18 into the contest, marking the second time in team history the Rangers scored within the opening two minutes of a third straight home game. J.T. Miller recorded a power-play goal 4:38 into the second before Gabe Perreault and Bjorkstrand scored in a span of 2:57 later in that period. Bjorkstrand finished off his second multi-goal game for the Rangers early in the third. It was his 23rd career multi-goal game. Alexis Lafreniere collected two assists, including a backhanded pass to Mika Zibanejad that led to Perreault's goal 10:17 into the second. Pavel Dorofeyev added an assist by setting up Durzi's goal on a night when he had five shots on target. Garand came within 69 seconds of his second career shutout before Nick Jensen and A.J. Greer scored late goals. The Ducks took their third straight loss and mustered little after peppering Garand at times in the opening 20 minutes. Anaheim also absorbed its first road loss (3-1-0) after extensive flight delays caused them to arrive at their hotel at around 2:30 a.m. ET. Anaheim backup goalie Ville Husso allowed five goals on 30 shots. Durzi opened the scoring when the Rangers maintained possession after Tye Kartye's shot from the left point hit the post. Kartye got his own rebound and sent the puck to Dorofeyev behind the net. Dorofeyev connected with Durzi for a shot from the right point that went by Husso, who was screened by Miller. Miller was left alone by Jackson Lacombe and Tim Washe in front of the net and easily deflected Fox's wrist shot for a 2-0 lead. Zibanejad threaded the puck through the slot for Perreault, who easily scored from the left edge of the crease into a vacated net with 9:43 remaining in the middle frame. After New York's Justin Dowling pressured Beckett Sennecke into a turnover along the right boards, Bjorkstrand gained possession in the middle of the slot and lifted the puck over Husso for a 4-0 lead. --Field Level Media

item.title: Japan yet to decide on defence budget funding, finance minister says
item.description: Japan has yet to decide on any specific means of funding a potential increase in defence spending, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday, when asked about the possibility of a corporate tax hike as a source of revenue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan has yet to decide on any specific means of funding a potential increase in defence spending, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Tuesday, when asked about the possibility of a corporate tax hike as a source of revenue. "At this point, there is absolutely no specific method that has been decided," Katayama told a regular news conference, adding that the government is assessing the scope of defence capabilities required and the appropriate level of spending needed to achieve them. Kyodo News reported on Saturday that an additional corporate tax increase has emerged within the government as a possible source of funding for a planned defence budget expansion. Citing multiple government sources, the report said annual defence spending under the new defence strategy for the next five years is likely to exceed 10 trillion yen ($63.08 billion), up from about 9 trillion yen for the current fiscal year. Japan has been [USN:L1N46117W TEXT:"under pressure"] from the US to raise defence spending to 3.5% of GDP, which it has said should be a global standard for allies. ($1 = 158.5300 yen)

item.title: Long losing streak front of mind for Canucks as Hurricanes visit
item.description: The Carolina Hurricanes continue their five-game road trip, looking to pick up a second win over the Vancouver Canucks in as many weeks when the two teams hit the ice Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Carolina Hurricanes continue their five-game road trip, looking to pick up a second win over the Vancouver Canucks in as many weeks when the two teams hit the ice Tuesday night. Carolina is looking to return to the win column after Sunday's 3-2 loss to the Calgary Flames, which snapped the Canes' seven-game winning streak. "This is the no-one-feels-sorry-for-you league. We just regroup. We still created a ton of offense," said Hurricanes coach Rod Brind'Amour. "(The Calgary) game could have looked different, but I still would have felt the same, because we're giving up way too much." Jalen Chatfield and Jesperi Kotkaniemi scored while goaltender Brandon Bussi made 31 saves for the Canes, who are 5-1-0 on the road this season. Sebastian Aho added an assist in the loss and has points (six goals, eight assists) in all but one game to start the season. "We just probably gave up way too much," said forward Jordan Martinook. "It felt like, especially in the third, (Calgary) started putting it on us a lot and they were just playing simple, like how we usually play." The Hurricanes will be without forward Taylor Hall, who was placed on injured reserve Monday with an upper-body injury. The 34-year-old has three goals and two assists in eight games this season. Hall is considered week-to-week. Forward Mark Jankowski (lower body) was also sent home from the road trip for further observation. With Hall and Jankowski on the shelf, the Canes have recalled forwards Bradly Nadeau and Felix Unger Sorum from the American Hockey League's Chicago Wolves. Tuesday is the second and final meeting between Carolina and Vancouver this season. The Canes thumped the Canucks 7-2 in Raleigh on Oct. 8. Logan Stankoven paced the Hurricanes offense with a hat trick, Andrei Svechnikov added a pair, while K'Andre Miller and Jankowski also scored. Sean Walker added four assists in the win. Vancouver entertains Carolina following a six-game road trip, looking to snap a seven-game losing streak. Forward Elias Pettersson and Linus Karlsson scored in Saturday's 4-2 loss to the Tampa Bay Lightning. Goaltender Kevin Lankinen made 31 saves for the Canucks, who picked up just one of a possible 12 points on the road trip and haven't won since a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Oct. 3. "The execution of details within our game, things that we've continuously talked about that are just non-negotiable," said Canucks coach Manny Malhotra. "We need to have them to be able to be successful. Getting in shot lanes, being tougher around our net, face-off details. "We continue to learn the lesson the hard way that when you don't do those things, pucks end up in the back of your net." Forward Marco Rossi, who missed Saturday's contest in Tampa Bay due to illness, missed Vancouver's practice on Monday. Tuesday is the start of a three-game homestand for the Canucks, who are 1-2-0 on home ice this season. Carolina won both meetings with Vancouver last season, outscoring the Canucks 10-7. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump warns Kansans that US will 'burn' like France if Democrats win
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Monday used violent unrest in France as an argument against Democrats in his battle to defend a Kansas Senate seat long held by Republicans but in danger of falling to his political opponents.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Monday used [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"violent unrest in France"] as an argument against Democrats in his battle to defend a Kansas Senate seat long held by Republicans but in danger of falling to his political opponents. Trump's rally on behalf of Republican incumbent Roger Marshall was his latest foray into conservative states where Republican candidates are on defense due to voter frustrations over the Iran war and rising prices. "I love you Kansas, but I'm here for a guy named Roger Marshall," Trump said. In a new addition to his stump speech, Trump pointed to widespread protests in France as a scenario that could erupt in the United States unless Republicans win. He provided no evidence. France in recent days has seen some of the worst unrest in years as huge protests over the cost of living and underfunded public services descended into riots and looting. Trump himself has struggled to make goods and services more affordable in the United States. In his speech, Trump turned to anti-immigrant and anti-Muslim rhetoric, the type that he used to fuel his three presidential campaigns. "We're not going to let that happen to this country," he said. "When you see burning steeples and raging fires in France, just remember that is what the radical Dumocrats want to do to America." Trump has been mocking Democrats by calling them Dumocrats. Rights advocates have [USN:L1N4620ZA TEXT:"repeatedly criticized"] Trump for his rhetoric over the years in which he has targeted and mocked immigrants and ethnic minority groups. Civil rights groups say such rhetoric normalizes discriminatory attitudes towards those communities. KANSAS COMPETITION Kansas, a conservative Midwestern state Trump won by 16 points in 2024, has not elected a Democrat to the US Senate in 94 years. First-term Senator Marshall is in a close fight with Democratic candidate Adam Hamilton, pastor of a Methodist megachurch, who is running against Trump’s tariff agenda and what he calls the president's “erratic leadership.” “He wants you to repent for being born White,” Trump said of Hamilton. Marshall, in remarks to the rally, led his campaign argument on cultural issues like stopping "radical Islam." He called Hamilton "too woke" for Kansas because he supports gay pride parades, which the crowd loudly booed. "We need someone who can sort heifers and steers," he said. In response, Hamilton's campaign spokesperson called Marshall's campaign "sinking." "Nothing said at the rally can distract from the fact Kansans are being crushed by rising gas and diesel prices, struggling to access affordable healthcare, and are tired of Washington corruption," the spokesperson, Tyson Brody, said. In a Monday video, Hamilton welcomed Trump to the state and said his supporters have “a place” in his campaign. Hamilton said he will work with Trump when it makes sense and stand up for Kansans when Washington policies hurt farmers and rural hospitals. The tightness of the race is emblematic of the challenges looming for Republicans in the November 3 midterm elections as they try to defy political headwinds and retain control of the Senate and the House of Representatives. Trump is deep into a 32-day campaign blitz, frequently going to friendly areas that he won handily in previous elections. One Republican familiar with Trump's midterm strategy said the president’s attention on rural parts of the country is in response to internal polling showing soft support from men 55 years and younger in rural areas nationwide, a voting bloc crucial to Trump’s 2024 presidential win. ECONOMIC CONCERNS The [USN:L6N46517O TEXT:"latest Reuters/Ipsos poll"], published on Monday, found that 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, a record low for the president. Democrats need a net gain of four seats in both the US House of Representatives and US Senate to overturn Republicans' narrow 218-214 and 53-47 majorities. In Park City, near Wichita, many rallygoers walked more than a mile across Interstate 135 to reach the rural arena, as a red-and-green truck stop sign flashed its latest prices above their heads: $3.98 for gas and $5.78 for diesel. That is up about 45% compared to average gas prices in the state last year, according to motoring club AAA. Economic concerns were palpable among Trump's most loyal supporters. “Being on disability, I don’t have much, but it seems like the prices are still going up and they need to come down. It feels like you’re having to search or hunt for food," said Monique Mullen, 59, a Republican voter from Hutchinson, Kansas, who takes care of her father. A small bloc of protesters gathered near the arena, including James Nightingale, a self-described independent from Halstead, Kansas. “I’m a farmer from Kansas and the Trump administration has decimated the farm economy in my area. Not only have his tariffs decimated our markets for grain sales, now he is bringing in imported beef from outside the country. What happened to ‘America First’?” he said. Kansans have proven a willingness to cross parties, as voters have elected a Democratic governor, Laura Kelly, for the last two terms. "I don't think it's ever easy to get elected here," said Gina Seman, a Trump voter from Towanda, Kansas, noting that Republican candidates in the past have taken their popularity for granted.

item.title: 相次ぐサイバー攻撃、金融機関にも「適切かつ迅速な対応促す」＝片山金融相
item.description:
Takaya Yamaguchi
［東京 ２０日 ロイター］ - 片山さつき金融担当相は２０日、日本企業へのサイバ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
相次ぐサイバー攻撃、金融機関にも「適切かつ迅速な対応促す」＝片山金融相 10:45 配信

写真は片山さつき金融担当相。8月3日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 片山さつき金融担当相は２０日、日本企業へのサイバー攻撃が相次ぐ現状を踏まえ、金融機関に対しても適切な対応を促す考えを示した。同日午前の閣議後会見で語った。

サイバー攻撃を巡り、金融機関には１０月９日に注意喚起を出していた。ただ、金融機関の委託先への不正アクセスを通じて個人情報が流出する事例もあり、片山金融相は「委託先などのリスク管理を含むサイバーセキュリティ対策も求めた」と述べた。

金融システムへの影響を未然に防ぐため、「サイバー攻撃の動向も踏まえながら、金融機関に対して適切かつ迅速な対応を促していく」としている。

item.title: Merger Monday channels old economy vibes
item.description: Daiichi Life's offer for Challenger, valuing the annuities giant at $5.7 bln, is one of five new or updated deals Down Under. Waste management, plumbing, coal and car leasing round out the tie-ups. For all the AI hype, established industries are bankers' bread and butter.
item.dc:creator: Antony Currie
item.content:encoded: What are investment bankers to do after the high-profile flop of the IPO billed as Australia's biggest this millennium? With egg still fresh on their faces from the implosion of AI neocloud [USN:L6N45V00W TEXT:"Firmus Technologies' $5.5 billion aborted"] debut, dealmakers kicked off Monday with five new or updated chunky takeovers. Old economy vibes remain the fee pool's bread and butter as tech and geopolitical turmoil roil global markets. Chief among them is a bid from Daiichi Life's (8750.T) Australia unit, TAL Daiichi Life Australia Pty, for the 80% it doesn't already own of Challenger (CGF.AX) . It values at some A$8 billion ($5.7 billion) the equity of Australia's largest annuity provider, whose board is considering the offer. The target, which provides a steady income for retirees in a country with an ageing population, is the antithesis of a data centre bet pumped up by AI exuberance. TAL's return on investment, including the initial stakes it bought last year, would only be around 6.4%, using estimated net operating profit for the 2028 financial year supplied by LSEG. That'd only rise to 7.2%, Breakingviews calculates, if the buyer, a Down Under stalwart for decades before Daiichi bought in 15 years ago, could cut a fifth of its target's expenses, which may be a stretch. But at least both are above Challenger's 5.8% cost of capital, per LSEG. The day's other new corporate marriage has actually benefitted from global volatility: coal. Miner New Hope (NHC.AX) is buying the remaining 74% it doesn't hold of unlisted smaller rival and neighbour Malabar Resources for A$1.3 billion ($907 million): the price of the polluting fossil fuel is up 25% since the US and Israel started their war against Iran. The acquirer is issuing shares to finance the purchase. But the new stock is barely a sixth of the value of what Firmus was aiming to sell and it is all going direct to Malabar investors. Of those two new deals, the only one of Firmus' underwriters that secured a role was Bank of America, advising TAL and Malabar. Rounding Monday's merger mania off was progress on three private equity plays for decidedly ho-hum industries: Pacific Equity Partners-owned SG Fleet won the four-way battle for FleetPartners (FPR.AX) , offering A$1.1 billion ($768 million) for its vehicle fleet management rival's shares. Brookfield appears to have secured plumbing firm Reliance Worldwide (RWC.AX) at a A$4.1 billion ($2.86 billion)enterprise value after a go-shop period ended with no other bidders. And EQT (EQTAB.ST) has all but sealed its first big purchase Down Under, agreeing after months of negotiations to buy waste management specialist Cleanaway (CWY.AX) at a A$9.3 billion ($6.5 billion) enterprise valuation . Of course, there's no guarantee any of these transactions get done: for example, Reliance's top shareholder is AustralianSuper, which late in the process scuppered [USN:L4N3D24GI TEXT:"Brookfield's pursuit of Origin"] Energy (ORG.AX) in 2023. And while the five deals could between them shovel A$350 million in fees into investment banks' coffers, assuming an average 1.5% rate, none on their own would match the A$215 million Firmus would have forked over. But there is perhaps no greater tonic for a failed AI deal than a retreat to the real world. Follow Antony Currie on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Daiichi Life's Australian business, TAL Daiichi Life Australia, has offered to buy the 79.5% of Challenger it doesn't already own in a deal that values the Australian annuity provider's equity at A$8.1 billion, the target revealed in a regulatory filing on October 19. The offer represents a premium of almost 20% to Challenger shares' closing price on October 16. Also on October 19, New Hope said it would buy the 74% it doesn't already hold of rival, unlisted coal miner Malabar Resources, in a deal valuing its equity at A$1.8 billion. New Hope will issue shares to Malabar investors to fund the transaction. Several other already announced transactions also progressed on October 19: private equity firm EQT and waste management company Cleanaway agreed to a deal that values the latter's enterprise at A$9.3 billion; SG Fleet, which is wholly owned by buyout shop Pacific Equity Partners, won the battle to take fleet-management rival FleetPartners private at an equity valuation of A$1.13 billion; and the go-shop period for Reliance Worldwide has ended, leaving Brookfield's A$4.1 billion offer a month ago for the plumbing group's enterprise as the only one standing. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: GCash owner Mynt edges higher in record Philippine IPO amid Asian selloff
item.description: Shares of fintech firm Mynt , operator of mobile wallet GCash, rose 1.7% in their market debut on Tuesday after the company raised 60.9 billion pesos ($966.99 million) in the largest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines.
item.dc:creator: Yantoultra Ngui, Karen Lema, Roshan Thomas
item.content:encoded: Shares of fintech firm Mynt (GCASH.PS) , operator of mobile wallet GCash, rose 1.7% in their market debut on Tuesday after the company raised 60.9 billion pesos ($966.99 million) in the largest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines. The stock opened at 6.63 pesos a share, up from its offer price of 6.60 pesos, before rising further to 6.71 pesos. The broader Philippine Stock Exchange index (.PSI) was down 0.02%. The firm's debut demonstrated investor demand for Mynt's payments business even as a [USN:L4N466020 TEXT:"broader selloff"] in AI-related shares made investors more selective about new tech listings. "It is a record and, more importantly, a statement of confidence in Mynt, in the Philippine economy and in the strength of our capital market," Philippine Stock Exchange President and Chief Executive Officer Ramon Monzon said. Mynt's listing came as South Korean AI firm Elice [USN:L1N466008 TEXT:"fell sharply"] in its market debut on Tuesday, highlighting a more cautious mood toward companies tied to the AI boom. Mynt President and CEO Martha Sazon said the listing marked a new stage in the company's effort to widen access to financial services for Filipinos who have long been outside the formal banking system. Nearly 90% of GCash customers come from low- to middle-income households, she said. Mynt, backed by Globe Telecom (GLO.PS) , Ant Group and Ayala Corp (AC.PS) , owns GCash, the Philippines' largest finance app, according to its prospectus. The platform offers payments, money transfers, lending, savings, investments and insurance products. The company had 41.5 million monthly active users in the three-month period that ended on June 30, or nearly 56% of the Philippines' adult population, according to its prospectus. GCash users completed payment transactions worth 9.84 trillion pesos in the first half of 2026. BIGGEST IN THE PHILIPPINES Mynt's IPO surpassed Monde Nissin's (MONDE.PS) 52.2-billion-peso IPO in 2021 to become the largest-ever IPO in the Philippines, according to data compiled by LSEG. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said the listing came at a time when the stock market needed renewed investor interest and broader participation, adding that attracting fresh capital remained a challenge. He said strong demand from local and international investors offered a "reason for optimism" and reflected continued confidence in Filipino enterprises. The Mynt IPO attracted more than 20 cornerstone investors, who committed about $500 million, or nearly 60% of the base deal, according to the company. Investors included BlackRock, Citadel, Fidelity International and the International Finance Corp. Mynt sold 8.03 billion shares at 6.60 pesos each. The exercise of an overallotment option increased the deal size to 60.9 billion pesos from 53 billion pesos. Mynt plans to use the proceeds to fund growth in its digital financial services business, product development and general corporate purposes, according to its prospectus. Mynt said that for the six-month period that ended on June 30, its net income rose 7.3% from a year earlier to 10.82 billion pesos. Revenue rose 10.4% to 43.27 billion pesos. ($1 = 62.9790 Philippine pesos)

item.title: 城内経財相、今月の日銀会合も「都合つけば出席」 利上げけん制改めて否定
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ２０日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 城内実経済財政相は２０日の閣議後会見で、２９－３０日に予定されている日銀の金融政策決定会合に都合がつけば出席したいと述べた。同時に、自身が日銀の利上げをけん制したとの一部報道を改めて否定し、今後、議決延期請求を行う可能性があるかとの質問には「高市早苗内閣は日銀の自主性を最大限尊重している」と回答した。

城内氏は１６日の会見で自身が日銀の利上げをけん制し議決延期請求を検討したとの毎日新聞報道を否定していたが、その後、改めて同紙が同様の内容を掲載したことに対し、利上げを止めるために議決延期請求権の行使を検討したことはないと反論した。自身に対して取材がなかったと強調した。

８月以降の米株市場の不安定な動きについては、「世界のＧＤＰ（国内総生産）の４分の１を占める米国経済は世界・日本経済に大きな影響がある」として「その動向を注視する」との考えを示した。

今年は世界で４番目となっている日本の名目ＧＤＰが来年は６位に転落するとのＩＭＦ（国際通貨基金）の見通しについて、ドル建ての名目ＧＤＰに一喜一憂せず成長戦略の実現などに注力すると語った。

item.title: Gold inches up on softer dollar as investors assess Fed rate outlook
item.description: Gold inched higher on Tuesday, helped by a softer US dollar, as market participants looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Sukanya Mitra
item.content:encoded: Gold inched higher on Tuesday, helped by a softer US dollar, as market participants looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates. Spot gold was up 0.1% at $4,145.22 per ounce by 0347 GMT, while US gold futures for December delivery rose 0.1% to $4,164.70. "The interesting dynamic is that there's going to be a big move, no matter what the Fed does, and the initial reaction... might be supportive of gold if they keep interest rates unchanged," said Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com. Recent comments from [USN:L6N462084 TEXT:"Fed"] officials signalling little [USN:L1N4600EO TEXT:"urgency"] for further policy tightening have tempered expectations of a rate hike at the central bank's October 27-28 policy meeting. According to CME's FedWatch Tool, traders are pricing in an 82% chance that the Fed will leave rates unchanged next week, but expectations for a hike in December remain at 89%. Higher interest rates typically weigh on gold prices because they increase the opportunity cost of holding bullion, which does not pay interest. The US dollar index (.DXY) softened on Tuesday, making greenback-priced bullion more affordable for buyers overseas. Rodda said a de-escalation of tensions in the Middle East and a decline in oil prices could provide a further boost to gold prices. Oil prices advanced on Tuesday, with Brent hovering around a [USN:L1N46601X TEXT:"five-month high"] as traders priced in a geopolitical risk premium after Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis [USN:S8N44M08Y TEXT:"said on Monday"] they carried out several attacks against Saudi energy, airport and military targets. Elsewhere, [USN:L1N465004 TEXT:"Bank of Japan"] Governor Kazuo Ueda said underlying inflation is "quite close" to the central bank's 2% target, with strong global AI demand adding to inflationary pressure from a tight job market, signalling scope for further rate increases. Among other metals, spot silver rose 0.7% to $57.48 per ounce, platinum gained 0.7% to $1,651.25 and palladium fell 0.2% to $1,117.87.

item.title: In search for Amelia Earhart's plane, tantalizing clue turns out to be tree debris
item.description: US-based explorers who voyaged to a tiny South Pacific island seeking to solve conclusively the 1937 disappearance of famed aviator Amelia Earhart have determined that an object they suspected was wreckage from her plane was a cluster of washed-up trees.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: US-based explorers who voyaged to a tiny South Pacific island seeking to solve conclusively the 1937 disappearance of famed aviator Amelia Earhart have determined that an object they suspected was wreckage from her plane was a cluster of washed-up trees. Leaders of the mission made the announcement on Monday. The [USN:L1N45S045 TEXT:"team set out"] this month from Los Angeles for the archipelago nation of Kiribati on a $900,000 expedition backed by private donors and Indiana's Purdue University, long affiliated with Earhart and her legacy. The objective was to learn whether an elongated, multi-pronged object detected by 2020 satellite imagery in the island's lagoon was a remnant of Earhart's long-missing twin-engine Lockheed Electra 10-E airplane. Such a finding would have decisively proven some scholars' hypothesis that Earhart and her navigator, Fred Noonan, crash-landed on or near the coral-ringed atoll and perished as castaways there, hundreds of miles from their intended refueling stop. 'ADVENTURE IS WORTHWHILE' "Unfortunately, we weren't able to find that smoking gun," Purdue general counsel and team member Steve Schultz said in a video message recorded on the island of Nikumaroro, part of the Phoenix Islands in Kiribati. Quoting Earhart, he added: "You know, Amelia herself said, 'Adventure is worthwhile in itself.'" After a week at the island, the team ultimately concluded that the "visual anomaly" picked up by satellite "was likely a collection of large trees" wedged in the sand at the lagoon, the expedition said in a statement. Much of that debris had fragmented and washed away since it was first spotted, leaving a smaller Y-shaped segment whose reflective surface - suggestive of metal - turned out to come from "its carbonate veneer," the team said in a statement. Two previous attempts to locate the aircraft's wreckage in the ocean around Nikumaroro also proved fruitless, and a plane-shaped sonar image captured elsewhere on the sea floor turned out to be a pile of rocks. Earhart and Noonan were last seen taking off in the Electra on July 2, 1937, from Papua New Guinea, during Earhart's multi-stage attempt to become the first woman to pilot a plane around the world, and the first aviator to circumnavigate the equator. Radio contact with the flight was lost the next day after Earhart, 39, reported "gas is running low," followed by her final known transmission giving her navigational line of position. CASTAWAY HYPOTHESIS 'REMAINS VERY STRONG' The disappearance spawned one of the largest air-sea searches ever undertaken, and endures as one of the great unsolved mysteries of the 20th century and aviation history. The expedition's leader, Richard Pettigrew, head of the Archaeological Legacy Institute of Eugene, Oregon, said evidence supporting the "castaway hypothesis," suggesting Earhart and Noonan died while marooned on Nikumaroro, "remains very strong." He cited the body of evidence collected during the past 30-plus years by veteran Earhart explorer Ric Gillespie, co-founder of The International Group for Historic Aircraft Recovery and author of the 2024 book "One More Good Flight: The Amelia Earhart Tragedy." His case includes multiple radio distress calls picked up in the days immediately after Earhart vanished with bearings that converge on Nikumaroro, and a 2018 forensic analysis of human bones recovered on the island in 1940 showing they belonged to a woman of Earhart's build and stature. Gillespie's investigation also encompassed such artifacts from the island as a woman's shoe, a compact case, a freckle cream jar and medicine vial, all dating to the 1930s, as well as remnants of a jackknife like one Earhart carried on the plane. Yet another piece of evidence is a photograph taken of the island's shoreline months after Earhart vanished showing an object that appears to be the Electra's landing gear. The Purdue expedition this month said it uncovered a number of other artifacts, including a steel tube 30 inches long found in the lagoon, that may yield additional evidence when studied. According to Gillespie, the plane has been lost to history, eventually swept by tides off the coral flat where it had landed and carried into the sea to sink and break apart in the surf. The official US government view of Earhart's fate has long been that her plane ran out of fuel and crashed at sea near its refueling destination of Howland Island, another dot of land about 400 miles (640 kilometers) northwest of Nikumaroro.

item.title: China leaves loan rates steady for 17th consecutive month
item.description: China kept its benchmark lending rates unchanged for the 17th straight month in October on Tuesday, in line with market expectations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China kept its benchmark lending rates unchanged for the 17th straight month in October on Tuesday, in line with market expectations. WHY IT'S IMPORTANT The steady loan prime rates (LPRs) suggest policymakers are in no rush to roll out fresh monetary easing after a strong third-quarter GDP outcome, as they focus on reforming the loan pricing framework and improving monetary policy transmission. BY THE NUMBERS The one-year loan prime rate (LPR) was kept at 3.00%, and the five-year LPR was unchanged at 3.50%. In a Reuters [USN:L1N46506U TEXT:"survey"] of 22 market participants conducted on Monday, all participants predicted no change to either of the two rates. CONTEXT China's central bank is [USN:P8N42J00P TEXT:"considering switching"] its main policy rate to the overnight reverse repurchase rate, in a shift aimed at improving the transmission of monetary policy to support the economy. The People's Bank of China will also issue policy guidance to advance reform of the loan pricing benchmark, shifting lending away from a relatively narrow reliance on the LPR toward a more diversified set of benchmarks, the bank's governor Pan Gongsheng said on Monday. Some financially strong companies could opt for either the overnight reverse repo rate or the LPR as the benchmark for floating-rate loans, while the overnight rate could also serve as an alternative pricing benchmark for bonds and financial derivatives, Pan said. China's economy [USN:L1N46501H TEXT:"expanded"] 4.5% year-on-year in the third quarter, topping forecasts and reducing the urgency for Beijing to step up support to meet its annual growth target. KEY QUOTES ** Huatai Securities "The latest announcement extends the shift in the policy rate anchor toward asset-side pricing, maintaining a gradual approach. The tiered design - giving large firms the option while keeping small and micro enterprises and individuals anchored to the LPR - is primarily aimed at avoiding a one-off shock to the existing pricing system." "As more corporate loans are linked to the overnight repo rate , the rate's fluctuation range is likely to narrow, enhancing the stability of liquidity conditions."

item.title: 原油先物下落、対ロ制裁免除を見極め 中東の供給懸念続く
item.description:
Anjana Anil
[２０日 ロイター] - アジア時間の原油先物は下落。市場は、ロシアのエネルギー輸出に絡む一部...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物下落、対ロ制裁免除を見極め　中東の供給懸念続く 10:31 配信

米テキサス州ミッドランド郊外で稼働する石油ポンプジャック。2025年6月、米テキサス州ミッドランドで撮影。REUTERS/Eli Hartman

Anjana Anil

[２０日 ロイター] - アジア時間の原油先物は下落。市場は、ロシアのエネルギー輸出に絡む一部の制裁と関税を免除する米大統領令の影響を見極めている。一方、サウジアラビアとイエメンでの攻撃を受け、中東からの供給が混乱するとの懸念がくすぶっている。

００１０ＧＭＴ（日本時間午前９時１０分）時点で、北海ブレント先物は０．４９ドル（０．４５％）安の１バレル＝１０９．０６ドル。２０日に期日を迎える米ＷＴＩ先物１１月限は０．３３％安の１０３．３２ドル。取引の中心となっている１２月限は０．４６ドル（０．４７％）安の９８．０８ドルとなっている。

北海ブレント先物は前営業日に一時１１０．７０ドルまで上昇し、５月２０日以来の高値を付けた。

トランプ大統領が１６日夜に発令した大統領令は、ロシア製品への関税や同国産の石油・ガスの購入に対する制裁措置など、米国の主要な対ロ制裁と関税を免除する内容。ただ、トランプ氏は１７日、この問題について最終決定はまだ発表していないと述べた。ルビオ米国務長官は、政府当局者が状況を評価するためにさらなる時間が必要だと語った。

国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）が先週発表したデータによると、ロシアの９月の原油生産量は日量６万５０００バレル増の８４３万バレルとなったが、前年同月を約８７万バレル下回った。

ＫＣＭトレードのチーフアナリスト、ティム・ウォーターラー氏は「ロシアからのディーゼル燃料供給が増える見通しは、理論上は需給逼迫の緩和につながるものの、トレーダーは湾岸地域のエネルギーインフラへの被害がさらに広がるリスクをはるかに重視しているようだ」と述べた。

イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１９日、サウジアラビアのエネルギー施設や空港、軍事施設に対して複数の攻撃を実施したと発表した。対象にはサウジ西部の紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにある国有石油企業サウジアラムコの施設、シャイバ油田、首都リヤドのキング・ハリド国際空港、アブハ空港が含まれるという。サウジ当局は直ちにこの主張を確認しておらず、ロイターも独自に確認できなかった。

また、イエメンのシャブワ州では１９日、暫定政府治安部隊の訓練施設がフーシ派の攻撃を受け、５８人が死亡、２００人以上が負傷した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：石油価格、イラン攻撃による急騰から持久戦へ コラム：ホルムズ封鎖で石油貿易に変化、米州が最大の受益者に アングル：世界の石油備蓄、イラン戦争長期化による大規模供給途絶を乗り切れるか 焦点：エジプト沖ドローン攻撃が脅かす原油輸送代替ルート、スエズ運河巡る安全性に懸念 アングル：原油価格、イラン紛争でも予想ほど急騰しなかった訳 最終更新: 10/20(火) 10:31 ロイター

item.title: ノルウェーの16歳未満ＳＮＳ禁止に有害規定、ＴｉｋＴｏｋなど対象
item.description: [オスロ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[オスロ １９日 ロイター] - ノルウェー政府は１９日、計画している子どもの交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）利用禁止措置に「有害なプラットフォーム」を対象とする規定を盛り込むと発表した。対象となるメッセージ・ゲームサービスとして、ロブロックス、スナップチャット、ＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）を挙げた。

政府は４月、１６歳未満の子どものＳＮＳ利用を禁止し、ハイテク企業に年齢確認の責任を負わせる法案を年内に議会に提出すると表明していたが、具体的なプラットフォーム名は挙げていなかった。

ボーグスリ子ども家族相は声明で「有害なコンテンツや依存性のある機能に触れることから、違法なマーケティング、見知らぬ人からの望まない接触まで、あらゆるリスクが含まれる」と述べた。

子ども家族省は、有害なプラットフォームを「設計、機能、コンテンツを通じて、子どもの情緒的、認知的、身体的発達や安全にリスクをもたらすＳＮＳ」と定義。「政府はティックトック、ロブロックス、スナップチャットなどのプラットフォームが法律の対象になると考えている」とした。他にどのアプリが対象になり得るかとの質問には直ちに回答しなかった。

一方、無害と判断されたメッセージサービスやゲームは引き続き利用できるとした。

スナップ、ロブロックス、ティックトックを運営するバイトダンスは、コメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

item.title: Super-sub Boland delivers for Australia again
item.description: A test career of cameo appearances and fleeting glories has been Scott Boland's lot since his explosive Ashes debut five years ago but the pace warrior has rarely let Australia down when given half a chance.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A test career of cameo appearances and fleeting glories has been Scott Boland's lot since his explosive Ashes debut five years ago but the pace warrior has rarely let Australia down when given half a chance. In Gqeberha, Boland has delivered again in his first test since January to give Australia the upper hand as they look to seal their three-match series against South Africa with a game to spare. The burly Victorian finished Monday's rain-hit day two with figures of 4-31 at St George's Park, leaving the hosts [USN:L6N46511W TEXT:"in trouble at 97 for 5"]. It takes a special bowler to deny world-class spinner Nathan Lyon a place in Australia's attack, no matter the surface or conditions. It takes an extraordinary one to operate at the highest level at the age of 37 and to hit the mark with such efficiency after a long period on the fringes. Boland knew of his selection in Australia's starting side only minutes before the toss but wasted no time finding his line and length. "Sometimes I'll take 30 balls just jumping through my action," he told reporters. "I did it the other day and it took six. I was feeling good." Boland struck in consecutive balls to remove Aiden Markram and David Bedingham on day one, then returned on day two to dismiss Marques Ackerman with his seventh ball of the afternoon. Matt Renshaw took a screamer of a slips catch to help Boland capture his fourth wicket with an edge off Ryan Rickelton's bat. Boland's haul so far in his 20th test has lowered his career bowling average to a tick over 18 -- the best of any bowler with 50 wickets since World War Two. He is Australia's oldest specialist test quick since Ray Lindwall in 1960. Heaven knows what Boland might have achieved with more opportunity in a lesser Australian attack -- or had he been plucked from Sheffield Shield obscurity well before his fairytale 2021 debut against England, when he took 6-7 at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. Boland said he was in no mood to slow down and would gladly play every test if selected. "I know I'm 37 and the oldest fast bowler to play for a while," he said. "But still feel like I'm going really well and my body's in good spot. I feel like I can do it for as long as I can."

item.title: Malaysia has made no commitment to provide financing support to AirAsia, ministry says
item.description: Malaysia has made no agreement or commitment to provide financial assistance to budget airline operator AirAsia, the finance ministry said, though it acknowledged concerns over the carrier's financial health following a jump in jet fuel prices.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Malaysia has made no agreement or commitment to provide financial assistance to budget airline operator AirAsia, the finance ministry said, though it acknowledged concerns over the carrier's financial health following a jump in jet fuel prices. Reuters [USN:L1N45Y02T TEXT:"reported"] this month, citing sources, that AirAsia was in talks with the government over potential support. The airline's co-founder Tony Fernandes said the talks focused on aviation-related costs such as airport charges and fuel, not financial assistance In a written parliamentary reply on Monday, the finance ministry said it was monitoring developments in Malaysia's aviation sector, including recent quarterly losses reported by AirAsia that were attributed to rising fuel costs stemming from the US-Israeli war with Iran The government was regularly engaging with aviation players and seeking views from industry and technical experts, as was the case for other economic sectors affected by the Middle East crisis, it said Any request for support from companies in any sector "will be considered based on the interests of the country and the people, the fiscal sustainability of the government and the protection of public funds, in accordance with applicable laws and procedures," the ministry said "To date, the government has not made any agreement or commitment to provide financing support to AirAsia, whether in the form of guarantees, loans or public fund injections," it said The ministry said AirAsia was a significant player in the aviation sector, accounting for around 41% of the 104.5 million passenger movements recorded at airports operated by Malaysia Airports Holdings in 2025 and almost 60% of domestic passenger movements The carrier also played a significant role in maintaining air connectivity in Malaysia's Sabah and Sarawak states on Borneo island, it said

item.title: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing seeks to raise up to $1.36 billion in Hong Kong listing
item.description: Chinese electronics components maker Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing , is seeking to raise up to HK$10.67 billion ($1.36 billion) in a Hong Kong listing, according to a regulatory filing lodged on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese electronics components maker Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing (002384.SZ) , is seeking to raise up to HK$10.67 billion ($1.36 billion) in a Hong Kong listing, according to a regulatory filing lodged on Tuesday. The Shenzhen-listed manufacturer of electronic circuit products is offering 113.8 million H shares at up to HK$93.80 each, joining a wave of mainland firms tapping a [USN:L8N463029 TEXT:"resurgent"] initial public offering market in the financial hub. Suzhou Dongshan Precision said proceeds from the offering would be used to build new and upgrade existing production facilities, including expanding high-speed EML chip and optical module manufacturing capacity in mainland China. Final pricing is scheduled for October 26, with trading of the shares expected to begin on October 28. Founded in 1998, Suzhou Dongshan Precision is the world's second-largest supplier of flexible printed circuit boards used in smartphones, automobiles and other electronic devices, according to the company's website . In Hong Kong, companies raised HK$388 billion through 118 listings in the first nine months of 2026, more than double from a year earlier, helped by strong investor appetite for Chinese technology-related stocks. ($1 = 7.8477 Hong Kong dollars)

item.title: Dollar and euro drift, yen slips as markets seek direction
item.description: The US dollar churned at the start of trading in Asia on Tuesday as a tepid recovery in investor confidence bolstered higher-yielding currencies, but growing political risk in Europe continued to test traders' nerves.
item.dc:creator: Gregor Hunter
item.content:encoded: The US dollar churned at the start of trading in Asia on Tuesday as a tepid recovery in investor confidence bolstered higher-yielding currencies, but growing political risk in Europe continued to test traders' nerves. The euro was steady at $1.1216, while the British pound rose 0.1% to $1.3308. The Australian dollar was up 0.1% at $0.6986, while its New Zealand counterpart nudged 0.1% higher to $0.5668. Against the yen , the US dollar was flat at 158.56 yen ahead of an auction of 20-year Japanese government bonds. "FX markets reflected the improvement in risk appetite, with higher-carry currencies finding buyers," said Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone Group in Melbourne. "Europe was less convincing," Weston said. "French sovereign risk is clearly being priced into European equities, but the euro's resilience suggests traders aren't yet treating it as a systemic European problem." French authorities set [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"curfews"] in several cities on Monday after nationwide anti-government protests plunged President Emmanuel Macron’s final months in office into [USN:L6N4650JF TEXT:"turmoil"]. In Italy, the government said it will [USN:L1N4650LE TEXT:"dispatch 500 troops"] after two days of unrest. "The spread of French government bonds over Germany has come under renewed widening pressure against the backdrop of violent protests grabbing the headlines," ING analysts wrote in a client note. "Tuesday will likely see more headlines around the 2027 budget, as (the French) Parliament is slated for a first formal vote on the revenue section of the finance bill." The spread between French and German 10-year government bonds widened 9.9 basis points on Monday to 147.3 basis points. The yield on the US 10-year Treasury bond was flat at 5.131%. The US dollar index , which measures the greenback's strength against six currencies, ended two days of loss on Monday, rising 0.2% to 101.98. Against the Chinese yuan , the dollar was flat at 6.6811 yuan in offshore trade after the People's Bank of China kept interest rates on hold, in line with market expectations. Bitcoin was flat at $81,906.58, while ether nudged 0.3% higher to $2,405.99.

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝キングス、シモンズがアキレス腱断裂で今季絶望の見通し
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のキングスは、ガードのベン・シモンズ（３０）が右アキレス腱を断裂し、手術を受けると発表した。今季中の復帰は絶望的と報じられている。

シモンズは１８日の練習中に負傷し、ＭＲＩ検査で断裂が確認された。交流サイトに投稿した声明で「これまでも精神的、肉体的、感情的に試される困難に直面してきたが、その全てを乗り越えてきた。今回のけがも私の歩みの新たな一章であり、物語の終わりではない」と述べた。

２０１６年のドラフト全体１位でセブンティシクサーズに指名されたシモンズは、１７─１８年シーズンに新人王を獲得。オールスターには３回選出されたが、近年は負傷に苦しみ、昨季は出場機会がなかった。

背中の手術からの復帰を目指していたシモンズは、オフシーズンの練習で高い評価を受け、９月４日にキングスと１年３５０万ドル（約５億５５００万円）の契約で合意した。

通算では３８３試合（先発３４４試合）に出場し、１試合平均１３．１得点、７．４リバウンド、７．２アシストを記録している。

item.title: 「なぜ俺たちの店を…」暴徒の襲撃受けたパリの食料品店員、怒りあらわ
item.description: 18日に撮影された目撃者の映像には、パリの食料品店の従業員が、暴徒に荒らされた店の前に立ち、集まった人々に向かって、暴力ではなく「品位」を持って当局に要求を訴えないのかと問いかける様子が映っている。フランス各地で高物価や公共サービスの低下に抗議するデモが行われ、17日には暴動に発展していた。 従業員は「要求を訴えるにも、やり方や礼儀がある。品位を持って訴えるべきだ。こんなやり方じゃないだろう」と語った。「私たちが何をした？
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: 18日に撮影された目撃者の映像には、パリの食料品店の従業員が、暴徒に荒らされた店の前に立ち、集まった人々に向かって、暴力ではなく「品位」を持って当局に要求を訴えないのかと問いかける様子が映っている。フランス各地で高物価や公共サービスの低下に抗議するデモが行われ、17日には暴動に発展していた。 従業員は「要求を訴えるにも、やり方や礼儀がある。品位を持って訴えるべきだ。こんなやり方じゃないだろう」と語った。「私たちが何をした？ これからどうやって生きていけばいい？」とも問いかけた。 ロイターは、映像に映る建物、道路の配置、電柱が現地の過去の映像・画像や衛星画像と一致することから、撮影場所を確認した。撮影日は、元の動画ファイルのメタデータで確認した。 今回の暴動は、フランスでここ数十年でも最悪規模のものとなっており、数千人が逮捕されている。 全土で数十万人が平和的にデモ行進する一方、一部の暴力的な集団が公共施設を標的にし、高級ブティックやスーパーで略奪を働き、警察車両や警察官を攻撃した。

item.title: テニス＝国枝が車いす部門の殿堂入り候補に、生涯ゴールデンスラム達成
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - 国際テニス殿堂が２０２７年度の殿堂入り候補者のリストを発表し、車いす部門で生涯ゴールデンスラムを達成した国枝慎吾が名を連ねた。

車いす部門は４年ごとに殿堂入りの検討対象となる。国枝は四大大会（グランドスラム）のシングルスで２８回、ダブルスで２２回、計５０回もの優勝と、四大大会全てを制した生涯グランドスラム、さらにパラリンピックでの金メダルも含めた生涯ゴールデンスラムの偉業を達成。世界ランキング１位の座に史上最長となる通算５８２週にわたって君臨した。

男子では０９年に全米オープン（ＯＰ）シングルスを制したフアンマルティン・デルポトロ（アルゼンチン）がノミネート。デルポトロは元世界ランキング３位で、ＡＴＰツアーを通算２２勝。１７年前の全米ＯＰでは準決勝でラファエル・ナダルを、決勝でロジャー・フェデラーを破り、自身唯一の四大大会タイトルを獲得した。特に決勝ではセットカウント１─２からの逆転で、５連覇中だったフェデラーの牙城を崩した。

女子では、ＷＴＡランキングで通算１２１週にわたり世界１位の座に就き、１９年に全仏ＯＰ、２１年にウィンブルドン選手権、２２年に全豪ＯＰでそれぞれ女子シングルスを制したアシュリー・バーティ（オーストラリア）と、四大大会のシングルスとダブルスでそれぞれ２回優勝し、ツアーではシングルス１８勝にダブルス１６勝、世界ランキングはシングルスで２位、ダブルスで３位を記録したロシア出身のスベトラーナ・クズネツォワも候補者リストに入った。

選手部門の候補者に対するファン投票は１０月２５日まで実施。ファン投票の結果はテニスジャーナリスト、歴史家、殿堂入り選手らで構成される「公式投票グループ」による投票結果にボーナスポイントとして加算される。殿堂入りには、公式投票グループの得票率とファン投票による加算分の合計が７５％以上となる必要がある。

item.title: 米ＪＰモルガン、国家安全保障に重要な産業に50億ドル投資
item.description:
Nupur Anand
[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースは、米経済と国家安全保...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＪＰモルガン、国家安全保障に重要な産業に50億ドル投資 10:08 配信

米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェース本社入り口の同社ロゴ。4月1日、米ニューヨーク市で撮影。REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

Nupur Anand

[ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター] - 米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースは、米経済と国家安全保障にとって極めて重要な産業に対して計５０億ドルの株式による投資を実施したと発表した。背景にはトランプ政権が国内でのインフラ整備を優先する中で、銀行各社が人工知能（ＡＩ）データセンターや重要鉱物、エネルギーインフラなどの需要の高まりに対応した投資を進めていることがある。

ＪＰモルガンは、経済安全保障やサプライチェーンの強化を目的として約１年前に設立したプログラム「セキュリティ・アンド・レジリエンシー・イニシアチブ」に則って約２３００億ドルを融資したことも公表した。このプログラムでは今後１０年間に国家安全保障を含めた国内投資に１兆５０００億ドルの資金を提供することを掲げている。

ＪＰモルガンの株式投資先はベンチャー企業や成長企業、後期段階の企業を対象とし、次世代防衛技術、分散型バッテリー貯蔵、工場の自動化、最先端技術への新規投資も含まれている。

セキュリティ・アンド・レジリエンシー・イニシアチブを率いるジェイ・ホライン氏は「次の段階では産業能力の拡大、サプライチェーン（供給網）の強化、そして長期的な経済の強靱化と国家安全保障を形づくる産業への支援に力を入れていく」との方針を示した。

他の金融大手ではバンク・オブ・アメリカが８月、米国のデジタルおよびインフラプロジェクトを支援するため２０２７年７月までに２５００億ドルを投資する計画を発表。モルガン・スタンレーも今後１０年間に技術およびインフラプロジェクトに１兆５０００億ドル規模の投資を実行すると表明している。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：出遅れ気味の米不動産株、持ち直し期待高まる 焦点：後退する米企業役員の多様性、トランプ米大統領の政策反映 アングル：ＪＰモルガン、時価総額1兆ドルの大台が目前 アングル：実を結ぶＪＰモルガン独自戦略、スタートアップを初期段階から全力支援 最終更新: 10/20(火) 10:08 ロイター

item.title: 加アルバータ州で分離独立問う住民投票、否決でも運動継続か
item.description:
Amanda Stephenson
[カルガリー １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Amanda Stephenson

[カルガリー １９日 ロイター] - 石油資源が豊富なカナダ西部アルバータ州で１９日、カナダからの分離独立の是非を問う、法的拘束力のない住民投票が行われている。分離派の敗北が広く予想されているが、それで論争に決着がつくとは考えていない人が多い。

世論調査では一貫して、州の有権者の過半数がカナダからの分離に反対している。独立運動を後押ししてきたのは経済面での不満だ。

アルバータ州の分離運動は、カーニー首相にさらなる圧力をかけている。カーニー氏は米国の関税措置や、カナダを米国の５１番目の州にすべきだとするトランプ米大統領の主張に直面する中、カナダの主権を守ることを中心的な使命に掲げている。

分離派の多くは、自由党主導の連邦政府が環境政策を通じ、保守系政党が政権を握るアルバータ州の石油産業を制約してきたと考えている。また、国内のエネルギー産業の中心である同州は、カナダ経済への貢献に見合う恩恵を受けていないと主張している。

分離独立を支持する広告団体「パスウェー・トゥー・インディペンデンス」の創設者、コリー・モーガン氏は「カナダの制度は不均衡で、アルバータのような周辺の生産州を犠牲にして、中央部の住民や政府を支えている」と述べた。

アルバータ州で育ったカーニー氏は、過去１週間の多くを残留派の運動に費やし、支持者に投票を呼びかけるとともに、国への誇りに訴えてきた。

投票は現地時間１９日午後８時（日本時間２０日午前１１時）に締め切られ、結果が判明し次第、順次公表される予定だった。

しかし、州選挙管理当局は、一部の投票所で開始が遅れたため、その分、終了時刻を延長すると発表。全ての投票所が閉まるまで暫定結果は公表しないとした。エドモントンの投票所１カ所では、終了時刻が１９日午後１０時（日本時間２０日午後１時）まで延長された。

item.title: Brent crude holds near five-month high on Middle East tension
item.description: Oil prices advanced on Tuesday, with Brent hovering around a five-month high as traders priced in a geopolitical risk premium from Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and reports of vessel attacks in the Gulf.
item.dc:creator: Anjana Anil, Siyi Liu
item.content:encoded: Oil prices advanced on Tuesday, with Brent hovering around a five-month high as traders priced in a geopolitical risk premium from Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and reports of vessel attacks in the Gulf. Brent crude futures climbed 55 cents, or 0.50%, to $110.10 a barrel by 0319 GMT, after rising as high as $110.70 a barrel in the previous session to their highest since May 20. The US West Texas Intermediate crude (WTI) contract for November delivery , set to expire on Tuesday, was up 0.24% to $103.91. The more-active December contract rose 39 cents, or 0.40%, to $98.93. "Oil prices remain well-supported ... This suggests the market is pricing in a significant risk premium, given the situation's volatility," ING analysts said in a note on Tuesday. "However, if flows continue uninhibited despite the geopolitical environment, the risk premium would likely erode slowly. Clearly, there are no signs of this yet." At least 18 vessels were reportedly attacked over two weeks, which keeps the risk premium intact, shiptracker Kpler said in a note on Monday. HOUTHIS CLAIM ATTACKS ON SAUDI FACILITIES Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said on Monday they launched [USN:S8N44M08Y TEXT:"several attacks"] on Saudi energy, airport and military targets, such as an Aramco (2222.SE) site in Yanbu, the Shaybah oilfield, Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport and Abha airport. Saudi authorities did not immediately confirm the claims and Reuters could not independently verify them. Also on Monday, a Houthi [USN:L1N46509O TEXT:"attack"] on a training camp for government security forces in Yemen's Shabwa province killed 58 people with more than 200 injured. The renewed attacks heightened fears about regional stability and underscored continuing risks to energy supply from the region, keeping oil prices above $100 a barrel. In the US, crude oil stockpiles were expected to have fallen last week along with product inventories, a preliminary Reuters [USN:L4N4651EI TEXT:"poll"] showed on Monday. Friday's [USN:L1N463009 TEXT:"executive order"] by President Donald Trump waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs, including goods duties and penalties for purchases of its energy. However, Trump said on Saturday he had yet to announce a [USN:L6N464042 TEXT:"final decision"] on the matter, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio said officials wanted more time to evaluate the situation. Russia's crude [USN:L1N46008R TEXT:"oil production"] increased by 65,000 barrels per day in September to 8.43 million bpd, but remained about 870,000 bpd below that of a year ago, the International Energy Agency said last week. "While the prospect of additional Russian diesel supply offers some theoretical relief, traders appear far more focused on the ongoing risk of further damage to energy infrastructure across the Gulf region," said Tim Waterer, KCM Trade chief analyst.

item.title: クラウド大手、まだ把握されないＡＩ関連債務存在も＝Ｓ＆Ｐ
item.description:
Marc Jones
[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは、世界の大手テクノロジー企業が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
クラウド大手、まだ把握されないＡＩ関連債務存在も＝Ｓ＆Ｐ 9:54 配信

AIのイメージ。10月19日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Marc Jones

[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米格付け会社Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルは、世界の大手テクノロジー企業が人工知能（ＡＩ）関連で抱える債務リスクについて、現時点で把握されている以上の潜在的負債が存在する可能性が高いとの見方を示した。一方で同社のデジタルインフラ部門責任者を務めるマーク・ハビブ氏は、現時点で主要企業の信用格付けを見直す必要はないとみている。

ハビブ氏はロンドンでの説明会で、大手クラウド事業者（ハイパースケーラー）の格付けにとって最大のリスクは、期待される利益が実現しないことだと指摘。その上でハイパースケーラーが大規模データセンター建設や小規模ＡＩ企業向けの資金調達を事実上保証する「相互連関型の金融スキーム」に言及するとともに「われわれが把握できていない債務がさらに存在すると考えるのが妥当だ」と述べた。

さらにハビブ氏は「（これらの取引が）開示対象になっていなければ、ハイパースケーラーの開示情報には含まれない。またこうした負債が発生する取引を当社が格付けしていなければ、実際のところ十分な可視性を持てない」と語った。

Ｓ＆Ｐは、アマゾン・ドット・コム、マイクロソフト、アルファベット、オラクル、メタ、スペースＸの米主要６社が、２０２５年から３０年までにデータセンターなどＡＩ関連設備投資として７兆ドル超を投じると予想し、少なくとも来年まではフリーキャッシュフローがマイナスになるとの見通しを示している。

ハビブ氏はこうした循環的な資金調達に伴う追加債務が企業のバランスシートにどの程度上乗せされるかについて推計はないとしつつも「全体像を総合的に捉えようとしている」と説明した。

Ｓ＆Ｐは７月、ＡＩ関連投資の大きさと「収益化への道筋が不透明」な点を理由として、オラクルの格付けを投資適格級の最低水準である「ＢＢＢマイナス」に引き下げている。

ただハビブ氏は最近のＡＩ投資ブームに関連した債券の急落について、投資家が格付け以上にリスクを意識している兆候かと質問されると「現時点では、格付け変更を迫るような大きな乖離があるとはみていない」と答えた。Ｓ＆Ｐの格付けは短期的な市場変動ではなく、長期的な視点に基づいているからだという。

一方でＡＩ関連支出の規模が持続不可能な水準に達したことが明らかになれば、見方を変える可能性があると強調。「ＡＩ企業による投資のさらなる拡大や、競争激化による収益成長率の低下など、さまざまな要因が考えられる」と付け加えた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/20(火) 9:54 ロイター

item.title: Cuba accuses US of letting terrorists operate with impunity after speedboat raid
item.description: Cuban law enforcement officials on Monday alleged that the US was allowing terrorists to operate with impunity on American soil, citing details of an investigation into a February speedboat incursion that led to a gun battle at sea, deaths and injuries on both sides.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cuban law enforcement officials on Monday alleged that the US was allowing terrorists to operate with impunity on American soil, citing details of an investigation into a February speedboat incursion that led to a gun battle at sea, deaths and injuries on both sides. On February 25, 10 Cuban exiles attempted to infiltrate the island nation by boat from the Florida Keys, armed with nearly 13,000 rounds of ammunition, 11 rifles, 15 handguns, Molotov cocktails, a VHF radio and Starlink satellite communication equipment, according to the Cuban investigation that was described by state-run media on Monday. Five were killed; the rest, including some who were wounded, are in custody and face terrorism charges, authorities said. Cuba said on Monday that its investigation, which included confessions from those detained by its authorities, found that some of those involved in training insurgents remain at large in the US. "It is also important to highlight ... the crimes still being committed today by individuals and organizations that, from within the United States, provided the property used to carry out these acts, arranged and secured land and maritime transport, and facilitated the purchase and stockpiling of weaponry," said Cuban prosecutor Edward Roberts. Cuban authorities accused Maritza Lugo Fernandez, a Cuban national residing in Florida, of helping to organize the alleged plot. Some of those detained confessed they had trained on a farm property in Florida owned by Lugo Fernandez, who leads the Florida-based "Partido Democrático 30 de Noviembre," or the Democratic Party of November 30. Lugo Fernandez denies the allegations. "For more than 40 years, that regime has accused me of being a terrorist - of everything they can possibly come up with ... ," she said in a clip included in the state-run media report. "Personally, I live with peace of mind; I’m not concerned about what they say because I am very clear - fully aware - that it is all a lie." Neither the US Embassy in Cuba nor the US Department of Justice responded to a Reuters request for comment on the Cuban government's allegations. Cuba and the FBI previously said they were cooperating on the investigation. According to Cuban authorities, several of those detained in February said they planned simultaneous attacks on police and border guard units in Matanzas, a province just east of Havana, with the goal of inciting an armed uprising and triggering a US military intervention. The accusations come as the US has piled pressure on Cuba's government, including a nine-month de facto fuel blockade and reinforced sanctions that have led to an unprecedented economic crisis on the island. The US has called the Cuban government corrupt and says it is seeking a change in leadership there.

item.title: South Korea central bank to hold rates on October 22, hike in November
item.description: The Bank of Korea will keep its key policy rate unchanged on Thursday after two consecutive increases but is expected to raise borrowing costs once more next month, a Reuters poll of economists found, as inflation remains above target and growth remains firm.
item.dc:creator: Renusri K
item.content:encoded: The Bank of Korea will keep its key policy rate unchanged on Thursday after two consecutive increases but is expected to raise borrowing costs once more next month, a Reuters poll of economists found, as inflation remains above target and growth remains firm. Consumer inflation eased to 2.9% in [USN:L1N45N18N TEXT:"September"] from 3.1% in August, but remained above the BOK's 2% target. Strong semiconductor-led growth, a recovery in domestic demand and elevated energy costs are likely to keep underlying price pressures firm. Still, the recent moderation in headline inflation and Governor Shin Hyun Song's call for time to assess the effects of the [USN:L4N44N0CI TEXT:"back-to-back"] hikes give policymakers room to pause this month rather than deliver a third consecutive increase. All 34 economists surveyed by Reuters from October 14 to 19 expected the Bank of Korea (BOK) to hold its seven-day repurchase rate (KROCRT=ECI) at 3.00% at its October 22 meeting. "We think the BOK will buy some time, but ... that does not mean it is done with the hiking cycle," said Jeeho Yoon, senior economist at BNP Paribas. "The risks are tilted to the upside, given that growth is very strong on the back of semiconductors. This strong growth will spread into the domestic sector and domestic demand, (leading) to inflationary pressures." WEIGHING FINANCIAL STABILITY RISKS Asia's fourth-largest economy grew [USN:L1N43O1HA TEXT:"0.6%"] in the April to June quarter and 3.7% from a year earlier. The poll forecasts 3.5% growth this year, while next week's third-quarter GDP data may show whether the export-led recovery is broadening into domestic demand. Inflation is forecast to average 2.7% this year before easing to 2.2% in 2027. With growth expected to remain firm and inflation above target, median forecasts in the survey showed the BOK raising its base rate to 3.25% at its November meeting, in line with the BOK's dot plot projection. The rate is then forecast to rise to 3.50% in the first quarter of 2027 and stay there for the rest of the year. This is 25 basis points above the forecast in the previous poll, conducted before the August decision. "The November hike is still likely because the BOK's CPI projections show inflation is expected to stay at about 2% for most of 2027," said Michelle Lam, an economist at Societe Generale, who expects two more rate hikes after October in her baseline scenario. "Also, if you look at the housing market, house prices are still rising. Even though household mortgage borrowing is slowing, it does not seem that rate hikes have done enough to slow the housing market. So there is still room for the BOK to hike." Beyond inflation and growth, the BOK is also weighing financial-stability risks, particularly developments in housing, household debt and financial markets. The benchmark KOSPI index (.KS11) hit a [USN:L1N46101G TEXT:"six-month low"] on Thursday and triggered a circuit breaker for the 10th time this year, underscoring heightened market volatility. "In terms of the household (wealth) effect, of course it will affect confidence but 50% of household assets are in housing and equities account for only 10%. The impact of an equity-market correction would not be as much as that of a correction in house prices," Lam added. "If the equity-market correction continues, I think that may also affect the BOK's pace of monetary policy tightening." ([USN:L6N45N0UX TEXT:"Other stories"] from Reuters global economic poll)

FAST

BENGALURU, Oct 20 : The Bank of Korea will keep its key policy rate unchanged on Thursday after two consecutive increases but is expected to raise borrowing costs once more next month, a Reuters poll of economists found, as inflation remains above target and growth remains firm. Consumer inflation eased to 2.9 per cent in September from 3.1 per cent in August, but remained above the BOK's 2 per cent target. Strong semiconductor-led growth, a recovery in domestic demand and elevated energy costs are likely to keep underlying price pressures firm. Still, the recent moderation in headline inflation and Governor Shin Hyun Song's call for time to assess the effects of the back-to-back hikes give policymakers room to pause this month rather than deliver a third consecutive increase. All 34 economists surveyed by Reuters from October 14 to 19 expected the Bank of Korea (BOK) to hold its seven-day repurchase rate at 3.00 per cent at its October 22 meeting.

"We think the BOK will buy some time, but ... that does not mean it is done with the hiking cycle," said Jeeho Yoon, senior economist at BNP Paribas. "The risks are tilted to the upside, given that growth is very strong on the back of semiconductors. This strong growth will spread into the domestic sector and domestic demand, (leading) to inflationary pressures." WEIGHING FINANCIAL STABILITY RISKS Asia's fourth-largest economy grew 0.6 per cent in the April to June quarter and 3.7 per cent from a year earlier. The poll forecasts 3.5 per cent growth this year, while next week's third-quarter GDP data may show whether the export-led recovery is broadening into domestic demand. Inflation is forecast to average 2.7 per cent this year before easing to 2.2 per cent in 2027. With growth expected to remain firm and inflation above target, median forecasts in the survey showed the BOK raising its base rate to 3.25 per cent at its November meeting, in line with the BOK's dot plot projection. The rate is then forecast to rise to 3.50 per cent in the first quarter of 2027 and stay there for the rest of the year. This is 25 basis points above the forecast in the previous poll, conducted before the August decision. "The November hike is still likely because the BOK's CPI projections show inflation is expected to stay at about 2 per cent for most of 2027," said Michelle Lam, an economist at Societe Generale, who expects two more rate hikes after October in her baseline scenario. "Also, if you look at the housing market, house prices are still rising. Even though household mortgage borrowing is slowing, it does not seem that rate hikes have done enough to slow the housing market. So there is still room for the BOK to hike." Beyond inflation and growth, the BOK is also weighing financial-stability risks, particularly developments in housing, household debt and financial markets. The benchmark KOSPI index hit a six-month low on Thursday and triggered a circuit breaker for the 10th time this year, underscoring heightened market volatility. "In terms of the household (wealth) effect, of course it will affect confidence but 50 per cent of household assets are in housing and equities account for only 10 per cent. The impact of an equity-market correction would not be as much as that of a correction in house prices," Lam added. "If the equity-market correction continues, I think that may also affect the BOK's pace of monetary policy tightening." (Other stories from Reuters global economic poll)
