item.title: テニス＝ジャパン・オープン、本玉が初戦敗退、坂詰は雨天中断
item.description: ［１９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１９日　ロイター］ - 女子テニスのジャパン・オープンは１９日、大阪市でシングルス１回戦を行い、本玉真唯はビクトリヤ・ゴルビッチ（スイス）に３─６、１─６のストレートで敗れた。

坂詰姫野は第８シードのケーティ・ボールター（英国）と対戦し、３─６、１─３とリードを許したところで雨天により試合が中断された。

ダブルス１回戦では、小堀桃子、清水綾乃組が二宮真琴、リュドミラ・キチェノク（ウクライナ）組に６─４、６─３で勝利。本玉、内島萌夏組は台湾ペアに３─６、３─６で敗れた。

シングルスではリリー・タガー（オーストリア）が第５シードのリュドミラ・サムソノワ（ロシア出身）を６─３、６─３で破る番狂わせを演じた。アシュリン・クルーガー（米国）も第６シードのジャニス・チェン（インドネシア）を６─４、６─４で破った。

item.title: Australia's Ingenia extends Warburg Pincus talks, grants due diligence access
item.description: Ingenia Communities Group said on Tuesday it has extended discussions with Warburg Pincus on a process deed and granted the US private-equity firm comprehensive due diligence access.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ingenia Communities Group (INA.AX) said on Tuesday it has extended discussions with Warburg Pincus on a process deed and granted the US private-equity firm comprehensive due diligence access. Ingenia said it would sign a process deed with Warburg Pincus no later than October 23, less than a week after it provided due dilligence to the US firm on an exclusive basis [USN:L4N45Q02W TEXT:"Earlier this month"], the Australian property developer opened its books to Warburg Pincus on a non-exclusive basis after receiving an improved takeover offer of [USN:L4N45K019 TEXT:"A$5.25 per share"] Warburg Pincus first approached Ingenia in [USN:L6N44Y09H TEXT:"early September"] with an offer of A$4.75 per share, which was later raised to [USN:L1N45D006 TEXT:"A$5.05 a share"] within two weeks Ingenia rejected the first two bids, saying they "substantially" undervalued the firm Ingenia's board said on Tuesday there was no certainty the Warburg Pincus proposal would result in a formal binding offer Ingenia continues to work with residential property developer Peet (PPC.AX) on its A$992.5 million acquisition announced in [USN:L4N44N00X TEXT:"late-August"] Shares of Ingenia were up as much as 9% and on track for their best session since September 7, if the current momentum persists

item.title: Asesinato de exfiscal anticorrupción es un sombrío hito en violencia política en Guatemala
item.description: El asesinato el fin de semana del abogado anticorrupción Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa, quien se hizo de poderosos enemigos al enfrentarse a la élite guatemalteca, constituye uno de los homicidios políticos más significativos del país en las últimas décadas, lo que reaviva la preocupación por la vulnerabilidad de quienes luchan contra la corrupción en Centroamérica.
item.dc:creator: Sofia Menchu, Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: El asesinato el fin de semana del abogado anticorrupción Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa, quien se hizo de poderosos enemigos al enfrentarse a la élite guatemalteca, constituye uno de los homicidios políticos más significativos del país en las últimas décadas, lo que reaviva la preocupación por la vulnerabilidad de quienes luchan contra la corrupción en Centroamérica. Familiares, amigos y simpatizantes velaron el lunes a Solórzano, de 43 años, dos días después de que sus agresores lo asesinaran a tiros en un centro deportivo de la Ciudad de Guatemala. Su sepelio está programado para el martes. La policía guatemalteca informó haber detenido a dos hombres vinculados al homicidio y dijo haber incautado un rifle tipo carabina y una motocicleta. Ambos fueron puestos en libertad el domingo sin cargos y mantienen su inocencia. La policía indicó que aún no ha determinado el móvil del crimen. Para los guatemaltecos, el crimen trajo a la memoria el sombrío asesinato en 1998 del obispo Juan José Gerardi, quien fue golpeado hasta la muerte dos días después de presentar un informe que documentaba las atrocidades de la guerra civil de la nación centroamericana, culpando al Ejército y a sus fuerzas aliadas de la mayor parte de la violencia. "Esa magnitud y relevancia (no habíamos visto) yo creo que desde 1998 que asesinaron al padre Gerardi", dijo Juan Francisco Sandoval, exjefe de la Fiscalía Especial contra la Impunidad de Guatemala. SOLÓRZANO SEÑALÓ A LA ÉLITE Solórzano Foppa era hijo de un combatiente que murió en la guerra civil en la década de 1980 y nieto de la aclamada poeta y activista Alaíde Foppa, quien fue secuestrada en 1980 y de la que nunca más se supo. El abogado pasó de fiscal adjunto a convertirse en una figura destacada en la lucha contra la corrupción. Trabajó con la CICIG, el grupo anticorrupción respaldado por la ONU, en el caso de soborno "La Línea", que provocó la caída del presidente Otto Pérez Molina en 2015. Como director de la agencia tributaria de Guatemala desde 2016, se centró en la élite empresarial. Obtuvo un acuerdo récord de 100 millones de dólares con la siderúrgica Aceros de Guatemala e hizo arrestar al dueño del hotel Camino Real por falsificación de facturas. Sus casos permitieron recuperar aproximadamente 280 millones de dólares en impuestos. "Él tenía muchos adversarios por su trabajo en la autoridad tributaria, tenía muchos adversarios de naturaleza política, sobre todo a partir de las denuncias públicas que él realizó", dijo Sandoval, quien conocía a Solórzano Foppa desde hacía 23 años. El exfiscal fue destituido en 2018 y la CICIG se vio obligada a dimitir como parte de una reacción violenta de la poderosa élite guatemalteca. En 2021, fue arrestado bajo acusaciones de irregularidades en la recolección de firmas para registrar un nuevo partido político. "Esto no me avergüenza, avergüenza a los que están robando", dijo Solórzano Foppa en aquel momento, mostrando las esposas en sus muñecas a los periodistas en el tribunal. "Esto demuestra que estamos afectando a las personas poderosas de este país", añadió. Posteriormente, un juez desestimó los cargos más graves. En 2023, se unió brevemente al equipo de defensa del periodista de investigación del país centroamericano José Rubén Zamora, arrestado por cargos de lavado de dinero pero que afirmó ser un preso político. Solórzano solía decir que existían vínculos entre bandas criminales y partidos políticos, así como con el sistema judicial. "Me duele mucho porque no era la forma de cómo cortarle la vida a un ciudadano que le ha servido tanto al país", dijo el exministro de Gobernación Francisco Rivas, amigo de Solórzano Foppa durante 20 años. "Era una persona muy luchadora, extraordinariamente valiente, muy fuerte en cuanto a sus convicciones y valores". El presidente Bernardo Arévalo, quien hizo campaña como defensor de la lucha contra la corrupción en las elecciones que ganó en 2023, también condenó el asesinato, calificándolo el sábado como un hecho "cobarde". "Sus autores, materiales e intelectuales deben pagar las consecuencias con todo el peso de la ley”, afirmó. Solórzano Foppa deja cuatro hijos: dos de su primer matrimonio y dos con una segunda pareja. El tío del abogado, el activista de derechos humanos Julio Solórzano, sugirió que el asesinato podría ser una forma de generar miedo y desconfianza y desestabilizar el país. "Esperamos que pronto se sepa quiénes fueron los autores, pero el impacto como un crimen político ahí está", dijo durante el velatorio del lunes.

item.title: ドイツ首相、経済界にＡＩへの投資を要請
item.description: [ベルリン／フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は１９日、「私たちは人工知能（ＡＩ）の飛躍的な進歩...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドイツ首相、経済界にＡＩへの投資を要請 9:24 配信

10月19日、ドイツのベルリンで開催された産業イベントで登壇する メルツ独首相とエヌビディアのフアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）。 REUTERS/Lisi Niesner

[ベルリン／フランクフルト １９日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は１９日、「私たちは人工知能（ＡＩ）の飛躍的な進歩に後押しされた、根本的な経済・技術変革の真っただ中にいる」とし、経済界の首脳らに対して「ＡＩが皆さんのデータを活用できるよう、門戸を開いてほしい」とＡＩへの投資と活用を進めるように呼びかけた。首都ベルリンで始まった産業イベントで語った。

イベントは２０日まで開かれ、ドイツ政府とエヌビディアはドイツの産業界でのＡＩ推進に向けた提携を発表する見通しだ。政府によると、経済省がエヌビディアと覚書を締結したが、詳細は明らかにされていない。

メルツ氏はイベントの開幕行事に米半導体大手エヌビディアのフアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）とともに登壇。ドイツ経済の立て直しと産業のアップデートに向けた取り組みでＡＩが果たす重要性を強調した。

ドイツの主要産業である自動車、化学、エンジニアリング企業が世界で激しい競争に直面する中で、極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」への支持が高まっている。支持率低迷にあえぐメルツ氏は、経済を成長させるよう強い圧力にさらされている。

メルツ氏はエヌビディアと協力することがドイツの将来の成功の鍵を握ると訴えた。フアン氏は、エヌビディアのソフトウエアを用いて高級自動運転タクシー（ロボタクシー）を開発しているメルセデス・ベンツなどのドイツの自動車メーカーとの協力関係を例示した。

シーメンスやドイツ銀行などが加盟するドイツの企業・投資家団体の報告書によると、２０３５年までにＡＩ、エネルギー、防衛などの分野で最大４兆１０００億ユーロ（約４兆６０００億ドル）の投資が見込まれている。

item.title: マイクロソフト、英データセンター契約撤退を発表 電力供給遅延で
item.description:
Paul Sandle
[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは１９日、米半導体大手エヌビディアが出資...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マイクロソフト、英データセンター契約撤退を発表　電力供給遅延で 9:22 配信

マイクロソフトのロゴ。2025年3月、仏パリ近郊で撮影。REUTERS/Gonzalo Fuentes

Paul Sandle

[ロンドン １９日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは１９日、米半導体大手エヌビディアが出資する英クラウドサービス企業エヌスケールの旗艦データセンターで主要顧客となる契約を撤回したと正式発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）分野で世界を主導するという英国の構想にとって大きな障害となる。

マイクロソフトは、デジタルインフラの構築や世界的なＡＩの成長支援など、エヌスケールとの提携を引き続き重視していると表明した。

マイクロソフトの広報担当者は、英エセックス州ラウトンのデータセンターに関する契約の解除について「今回の決定は１カ所の施設に関するもの」と説明。エヌスケールは同施設で電力接続の遅延に直面しており、供給開始は２０３０年代になる見通しだという。

エヌスケールの広報担当者はロイターに「マイクロソフトとの関係は引き続き強固かつ長期的なものであり、ロンドン全域に及ぶ今回の残念な電力網の問題は、当社の他の契約には影響しない」と説明。「ラウトンの事業と英国への取り組みを継続する方針に変わりはなく、この施設の代替電源に加え、英国での事業拡大に向けた他の候補地も検討している」と語った。

マイクロソフトの契約撤回は英紙テレグラフが最初に報じた。

item.title: 日経平均は続落で寄り付く、ＡＩ株に売り先行 原油・金利高止まりも重し
item.description: [東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．２５％（１６１円２１銭）安の６万...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は続落で寄り付く、ＡＩ株に売り先行　原油・金利高止まりも重し 9:19 配信

東京証券取引所で4月撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．２５％（１６１円２１銭）安の６万４７５５円４９銭と、続落してスタートした。米国市場では半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）が９営業日ぶりに反発したが、国内の関連株は売りが先行している。

米コアウィーブCRWV.Oを巡る懸念がくすぶる中、原油価格や米金利の高止まりも重し。日経平均は寄り付き後、０．８％（５５０円）安にやや下げを拡大している。

ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連はアドバンテスト6857.Tや東京エレクトロン8035.Tが１％超安となっている。ソフトバンクグループ9984.Tは３％超安となっている。主力株はトヨタ自動車7203.Tやソニーグループ6758.Tが小安い。指数寄与度の高いファーストリテイリング9983.Tは小じっかり。

item.title: South Korea's Elice plunges 30% in market debut as data centre stocks shunned
item.description: Shares in South Korean AI services firm Elice Group plummeted 30% in their market debut on Tuesday, amid a sharp retreat in sentiment towards the sector that has also derailed other planned listings.
item.dc:creator: Heejin Kim, Yantoultra Ngui
item.content:encoded: Shares in South Korean AI services firm Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) plummeted 30% in their market debut on Tuesday, amid a sharp retreat in sentiment towards the sector that has also derailed other planned listings. Elice, which raised 201.1 billion won ($150 million) in its IPO, provides AI cloud services as well as AI-based education and business software and plans to spend most of its IPO proceeds on launching portable modular data centres and related infrastructure. Investors are increasingly questioning whether massive AI spending can pay off anytime soon as elevated inflation keeps borrowing costs high. Analysts noted that Elice's IPO had been priced on October 6, before the recent selloff in AI-related stocks. "Elice's debut shows the AI infrastructure trade has moved from 'build at any cost' to 'who is paying and for how long'," said Ke Yan, head of research at Singapore-based Shenton Research. "Until the AI labs that rent ... capacity show they can fund their compute commitments, new listings across the region will likely be priced in that risk premium." This month, data centre firms that have shelved their IPO plans include Australia's [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"Firmus"], which is backed by Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Blackstone (BX.N) -backed [USN:L4N45Z0H4 TEXT:"AirTrunk"], which postponed a Singapore REIT IPO, as well as [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"SB Energy"], a unit of Japanese tech investment conglomerate SoftBank (9984.T) , which had filed paperwork for a US IPO. "Everyone is not sure how much demand for AI there will be and it is hard to estimate current demand," added Kim Hak-joon, an analyst at Seoul-based Kiwoom Securities. Elice's shares were last trading at 63,600 won compared with its IPO pricing of 90,500 won. The IPO drew institutional orders worth 388.84 times the shares available in the offering, according to a filing. The company has said revenue for the first half of the year tripled to 34 billion won and that it swung to an operating profit of 10 billion won compared with a 3.5 billion won loss for the same period a year earlier.

item.title: Lula nega que tenha armado bomba fiscal com medidas recentes
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que busca a reeleição, negou nesta segunda-feira que medidas adotadas por seu governo nos últimos dias como o reajuste do Bolsa Família e o perdão de dívidas de microempreendedores individuais (MEI) sejam uma bomba fiscal e afirmou que há espaço no orçamento para todas elas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que busca a reeleição, negou nesta segunda-feira que medidas adotadas por seu governo nos últimos dias como o reajuste do Bolsa Família e o perdão de dívidas de microempreendedores individuais (MEI) sejam uma bomba fiscal e afirmou que há espaço no orçamento para todas elas. "Eu não sei de onde você tirou essa ideia de que é uma bomba que vai estourar...Não é bomba", disse o presidente a uma das jornalistas que o entrevistava. "Tudo o que está sendo aprovado está nas possibilidades fiscais e no orçamento", afirmou. Especialistas do mercado financeiro avaliam as medidas como eleitoreiras e consideram que devem impactar negativamente as contas públicas. "Eu não preciso aprender responsabilidade com a Faria Lima. Responsabilidade eu tenho, porque eu sei como pai de família, como trabalhador de fábrica que recebe salário, que a gente não pode gastar o que a gente não tem e portanto nós estamos gastando aquilo que nós sabemos que é possível fazer e vamos fazer", disse Lula, na entrevista. Mais cedo nesta segunda-feira, Ministério do Planejamento e Orçamento informou em nota à imprensa que deve remanejar cerca de R$20 bilhões das contas federais de 2027 para acomodar medidas adotadas recentemente, destacando que o valor corresponde a pouco mais de 1% do total de despesas sujeitas ao limite de gastos. Sem detalhar a quais ações esse impacto se refere, a pasta disse na nota que os ajustes serão propostos ao Congresso Nacional mantendo o limite total das despesas e a meta de resultado primário.

item.title: Report: Multiple teams in mix to acquire Jets G Connor Hellebuyck
item.description: At least three teams remain involved in trade discussions for Winnipeg Jets goaltender Connor Hellebuyck as the end of his team-issued suspension approaches, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least three teams remain involved in trade discussions for Winnipeg Jets goaltender Connor Hellebuyck as the end of his team-issued suspension approaches, ESPN reported Monday. A deal is not guaranteed before Hellebuyck's suspension expires Friday, according to the report. If Winnipeg still has not moved him, the Jets are expected to begin paying the three-time Vezina Trophy winner while continuing to keep him away from the team. Hellebuyck, 33, has been suspended without pay since failing to report for training camp after requesting a trade during the offseason. Sportsnet reported Saturday that Hellebuyck informed Winnipeg before its Oct. 2 season opener that he intended to return. The Jets then exercised their authority to impose a disciplinary suspension scheduled to expire Oct. 23. The NHL's collective bargaining agreement permits a disciplinary suspension of a "reasonable length" for a player who returns after missing training camp without permission. Hellebuyck has forfeited nearly $39,000 per day in salary, bringing his estimated losses to nearly $800,000 through Monday, according to ESPN. He has continued skating regularly in Michigan. The former Hart Trophy winner asked Winnipeg to move him this summer after spending his entire NHL career with the franchise. Hellebuyck has a full no-movement clause, giving him control over any potential destination. He is in the third season of a seven-year, $59.5 million contract. His no-movement protection changes to a modified no-trade clause next summer. Hellebuyck won his third Vezina Trophy in 2025 and also captured the Hart Trophy as the NHL's most valuable player that season. He helped the United States win Olympic gold in February. Winnipeg has opened the season 4-2-2 without Hellebuyck, with Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson handling the goaltending duties while general manager Kevin Cheveldayoff continues exploring trade options. --Field Level Media

item.title: Waymo plans to quintuple fleet to 20,000, Semafor reports
item.description: Alphabet's self-driving unit Waymo plans to expand its fleet five-fold to 20,000 by the end of next year using $5 billion it raised earlier this month, Semafor reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) self-driving unit Waymo plans to expand its fleet five-fold to 20,000 by the end of next year using [USN:L6N45U0Z0 TEXT:"$5 billion"] it raised earlier this month, Semafor reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter. The autonomous ride-hailing service provider, which currently has 4,000 cars, wants to expand it to 8,000 by the end of the year and grow it to 20,000 by the end of next year, Semafor reported Waymo did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours Waymo [USN:L6N45U0Z0 TEXT:"secured"] a $5 billion loan earlier this month from lenders including PIMCO, Blackstone and Sixth Street, and said it will use the funds to expand its services across the US and internationally Waymo operates in 15 US cities and has announced plans to roll out rides in [USN:L3N3VV1J3 TEXT:"London"], [USN:L1N457018 TEXT:"Tokyo"], [USN:L6N4590GI TEXT:"Singapore"] and [USN:L6N4620LY TEXT:"Canada"] The company closed a [USN:L4N3YY1ZH TEXT:"$16 billion"] equity raise earlier this year at a valuation of $126 billion

item.title: Exclusive-OpenAI seeks to accelerate fundraising ahead of Anthropic IPO, sources say
item.description: NEW YORK, Oct 19 : OpenAI is racing to secure investor commitments before rival Anthropic's expected public market debut in mid-November, in an unusually fast fundraising that could value the ChatGPT maker at over $1.4 trillion, according to two people familiar with the matter.The rapid timetable reflects,
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-OpenAI seeks to accelerate fundraising ahead of Anthropic IPO, sources say

FILE PHOTO: OpenAI logo is seen in this illustration created on June 11, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

20 Oct 2026 07:22AM (Updated: 20 Oct 2026 07:39AM)

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 19 : OpenAI is racing to secure investor commitments before rival Anthropic's expected public market debut in mid-November, in an unusually fast fundraising that could value the ChatGPT maker at over $1.4 trillion, according to two people familiar with the matter. The rapid timetable reflects, in part, a desire to get ahead of Anthropic as the two frontier labs are increasingly tapping in to a similar investor base, the people said, adding that OpenAI wants to capitalize on its recent revenue growth after launching new models. SoftBank Group, Abu Dhabi-based MGX and other existing backers of OpenAI are in talks to join the round of about $30 billion, one of the people said.  The acceleration underscores how closely the two AI developers are competing for capital as both pursue trillion-dollar price tags, amid growing concern about rising interest rates, significant volatility in technology stocks and rising scrutiny of AI valuations. OpenAI held meetings with long-only funds and sovereign wealth funds last week while Anthropic was hosting its own investor day. OpenAI's funding round is expected to move faster than is typical for an offering of its size, the people said.

Investors familiar with the company say OpenAI also needs capital to fund its substantial infrastructure commitments and bolster its balance sheet if a deterioration in the IPO markets further delays its planned 2027 listing.  Though there is high demand for the shares of both companies, investors face the challenge of evaluating and allocating capital to two complex, competing offerings within days or weeks of each other. Some investors view OpenAI’s financing push as an effort to lock in capital from funds that might otherwise devote more of their resources to Anthropic’s IPO, the people said.  OpenAI and SoftBank declined to comment. Anthropic and MGX did not immediately respond to requests for comment. TRYING TO HEAD OFF COMPARISONS OpenAI is pitching investors on growth that accelerated after the launch of its GPT-6 Astra model, saying it had reached $50 billion in annualized revenue and expecting that figure to rise to $70 billion by year-end, according to one of the people. OpenAI has also cut prices on its cheaper models, which it said has boosted usage, and told investors it can further lower the price of AI models, the person added.  Anthropic's annualized revenue reached roughly $65 billion by July, Reuters previously reported. Its quarterly revenue jumped to $16.8 billion in the third quarter from $11.6 billion in the second quarter this year, it told investors, but slowing month-to-month revenue growth has raised concerns among investors about its valuation. OpenAI is seeking to complete the fundraising before Anthropic’s financial disclosures give investors a fuller picture of its business and invite comparisons between the two companies, one person said.  The disclosures could prompt investors to press OpenAI Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar for more details about the company’s revenue growth and financial outlook, the person added. OpenAI records revenue on a net basis by subtracting partner shares upfront. It has accused Anthropic of inflating its revenue by counting  the full, gross value of contracts sold through third-party cloud providers. Anthropic told Reuters earlier that it follows established accounting practices. "OpenAI could want to set its own valuation and not have to worry about a comp (comparison)," said Edward Best, co-chair of capital markets at Willkie Farr & Gallagher, who is not working on the deal and commented on a hypothetical basis. "It's really a two-horse race in terms of being public."  OpenAI was last valued at $852 billion in March this year, after a record-breaking $122 billion funding round, including a commitment from Amazon.com, which agreed to invest up to $50 billion in the lab.  The Financial Times previously reported some details of OpenAI’s potential fundraising.   IPO PLANS HIT BY MARKET JITTERS A number of companies preparing to go public have decided to wait until after Anthropic’s planned IPO, wary of competing for investor demand amid market volatility and a pullback in AI stocks, bankers and investors said. Some late-stage companies are also timing private fundraising rounds to avoid coinciding with Anthropic’s expected debut, the bankers and investors said. Some existing and prospective Anthropic investors have argued for a valuation closer to $1.5 trillion for its market debut — instead of the desired $2 trillion — after the AI startup's third-quarter results fell short of expectations, Reuters reported last week. The reassessment comes amid a choppy market since September, with volatility in oil prices, rising bond yields and growing concerns about AI safety weighing on investor appetite for technology stocks. Investors are also scrutinizing the cost of AI infrastructure, including the debt needed to finance the data centers powering the boom. At the center of the latest concerns is cloud provider CoreWeave, whose shares and debt tumbled last week as investors scrutinized the nearly $50 billion in borrowings used to fund its rapid expansion.  The uncertainty has disrupted what had been expected to be a busy autumn for IPOs, with companies reassessing their listing plans amid market volatility and concerns about valuations. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT, Nvidia-backed Firmus and SoftBank-backed SB Energy have either pulled or paused their listings.  Nuclear services company Holtec cited a "perfect storm," driven mainly by uncertainty around data-center demand, when it pulled its US listing last month. Companies in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, widely viewed as a proxy for AI-related semiconductor demand, have shed $1.6 trillion in less than two weeks, while AI infrastructure companies have come under particular pressure.

Source: Reuters

item.title: カナダ9月の消費者物価、前年比上昇率が3.1％に拡大
item.description:
Promit Mukherjee
[オタワ １９日 ロイター] - カナダ統計局が１９日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
カナダ9月の消費者物価、前年比上昇率が3.1％に拡大 8:05 配信

食料品店で買い物をする人ら。1月26日、カナダ・オンタリオ州ミシサガで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Osorio

Promit Mukherjee

[オタワ １９日 ロイター] - カナダ統計局が１９日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前年同月比上昇率が３．１％となり、カナダ銀行（中央銀行）のインフレ目標圏（１―３％）を３カ月ぶりに上回った。ガソリンとディーゼル燃料（軽油）の価格高騰が全体を押し上げた。

ロイターがアナリストらに調査した市場予想は３．２％、８月は３．０％だった。

・９月のＣＰＩの前月比は０．１％上昇。８月は０．１％下落していた。

・カナダ銀行は今月２８日の次回会合で政策金利を２．２５％に据え置くとの見方が優勢。１２月には２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが織り込まれている。

・カナダ銀行のティフ・マックレム総裁は、今月２８日に発表する四半期のインフレ見通しを大幅に引き上げる見込みを明らかにしている。

・９月のＣＰＩの前年同月比が上昇したのは、エネルギー価格が１９％上昇したことが主因。ガソリン価格は２７．８％上がった。ガソリン価格の影響を除いたインフレ率は２．２％となり、８月の２．４％から縮小した。

・９月の食品のインフレ率は１．７％で２０２４年５月以来、２年４カ月ぶりの低水準。

・住居費のインフレ率は１．８％、家賃は２．８％だった。

・航空運賃は１９．４％上昇。旅行代金のインフレ率は８月から縮小した。

・構成品目変動率の中央値を示す「ＣＰＩメジアン」は９月に１．９％、極端な価格変動の項目を除外した「ＣＰＩトリム」は１．８％だった。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：カナダ首相の対米強硬姿勢に高い国内支持、貿易戦争長期化で風向き一変も 焦点：中国車メーカー、カナダ進出に本腰　米市場開放にらみ「予行演習」 アングル：アルバータ州、天然ガスでデータセンター誘致　カナダ政府の環境政策と対立 焦点：カナダ、トランプ関税後の新貿易秩序に布石　中国などと協定加速 最終更新: 10/20(火) 8:05 ロイター

item.title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu in unannounced visit to Israel, Axios reports
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during an unannounced visit to Israel on Monday, Axios reported, citing two sources with knowledge.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during an unannounced visit to Israel on Monday, Axios reported, citing two sources with knowledge. Reuters could not immediately confirm the meeting, but Hegseth said in a social media post that he had visited US service members in the Central Command area of responsibility, which covers the Middle East, northeast Africa and parts of Asia. The Pentagon declined comment, while Israel's embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. News of Hegseth's trip comes a day after US President Donald Trump [USN:L1N46403J TEXT:"endorsed"] Netanyahu in next week's parliamentary election in Israel - its first vote since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023, that shook the country and plunged the Middle East into turmoil, as Israel went to war in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran. Netanyahu's religious-nationalist coalition is projected to lose its governing majority, although the opposition may also struggle to form a government, opinion polls show. US Vice President JD Vance, however, declined to endorse Netanyahu in an interview earlier on Monday, saying he was not getting involved in Israeli elections. "I endorse American candidates, and that's where I'm focused on is the midterms," Vance, who traveled to Budapest and [USN:L1N40Q06M TEXT:"endorsed"] Viktor Orban in Hungarian election earlier this year, said in an interview with digital media outlet 2WAY. "I'm not anti-endorsing him, but I'm not pro-endorsing him, I'm not getting involved in Israeli elections." Vance said.

item.title: エヌスケール、アンソロピック向けＡＩ計算能力追加提供を協議＝関係者
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] - データセンター事業者の英新興エヌスケールが、対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を開発する米ア...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌスケール、アンソロピック向けＡＩ計算能力追加提供を協議＝関係者 7:37 配信

米アンソロピックのロゴ。2024年5月に撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[１９日 ロイター] - データセンター事業者の英新興エヌスケールが、対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を開発する米アンソロピック向けにＡＩ計算能力を提供する新たな契約について協議している。事情に詳しい関係者が１９日ロイターに明かした。契約額は約４５０億ドルに上る可能性がある。

関係者の話では、エヌスケールは米南部ウェストバージニア州の「モナーク」データセンター・キャンパス内の第２棟について、アンソロピックとの大型契約締結を目指している。

アンソロピックは既に８月、同州のモナーク・キャンパスの第１棟でエヌスケールが提供するＡＩクラウドコンピューティング能力を借り受けるため、４５０億ドルを支払う契約を結んだ。第２棟では、エヌビディアの先進ＡＩチップ「ベラ・ルービン」を使用し、４６０メガワットの計算能力を提供する計画という。

アンソロピックはロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。

関係者は、アンソロピックはモナーク第３棟についても優先交渉権を保有していると述べた。ただ協議は継続中で、計画の詳細は変更される可能性がある。

今回の提携協議は、マイクロソフトがエヌスケールの主力データセンター案件から撤退した後に浮上した。撤退の背景には、電力接続の遅れにより、電力供給開始時期が２０３０年代にずれ込む見通しとなったことがあった。

エヌスケールは創業以来急成長を続けており、２年半で契約総額を１億ドルから１０３０億ドル超へ拡大した。コアウィーブ、ネビウス、クルーソー、ラムダなどが競合相手だ。エヌスケールの目論見書によると、将来的にはマイクロソフトとアンソロピックが同社の主要顧客となる見通しとなっている。

item.title: US says travelers should reconsider Kenya trips on health risks amid Ebola spread
item.description: The US State Department said on Monday it has asked Americans to reconsider any travel to Kenya and raised its travel advisory for the African nation due to health risks.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: The US State Department said on Monday it has asked Americans to reconsider any travel to Kenya and raised its travel advisory for the African nation due to health risks. "The level was changed from Level 2 to Level 3 due to health risks," the travel advisory by the US embassy in Kenya said. The advisory was raised to level 3, which asks Americans to reconsider travel, from an earlier level 2 that urges increased caution. "Reconsider travel to Kenya due to risk of health, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, and traffic safety. Some areas have increased risk," the advisory read. Kenya confirmed [USN:L8N4640AV TEXT:"one more Ebola case"] on Sunday, bringing the total number of infections in the country to eight. Kenya has been on heightened alert, as a major Ebola outbreak centered in Congo [USN:L1N46401K TEXT:"has spread"] across borders in the region. Congo confirmed on Sunday that its outbreak had spread to an eighth province, North Ubangi, underscoring concerns about wider regional transmission. "Medical services in Kenya are limited. They are often unavailable in rural areas. Medical facilities in Kenya often lack sufficient medicine and equipment," the US travel advisory on Kenya said in its summary.

item.title: Australian lawmaker loses leg after vehicle attack being probed by anti-terror police
item.description: Doctors have amputated the leg of an Australian lawmaker after a man rammed her with his car and then reversed to hit her a second time, local media and officials said on Tuesday, in an incident being investigated by anti-terrorism police.
item.dc:creator: Renju Jose
item.content:encoded: Doctors have amputated the leg of an Australian lawmaker after a man rammed her with his car and then reversed to hit her a second time, local media and officials said on Tuesday, in an incident being investigated by anti-terrorism police. Helen Haines, an independent, underwent surgery overnight and remained in critical condition after Monday's attack in the small rural town of Wangaratta, north of Melbourne. The motive for the attack has yet to be revealed, but Australia’s prime minister has linked it to a climate of ugly, polarised political debate in the country. "It's clear that there was a deliberate act here. This wasn't an accident, someone just skidding off the road," Albanese told ABC News. Early investigations suggested the car hit Haines as she was loading or unloading things from the trunk of her car, he said. Australian media, citing unidentified sources, reported Haines had lost one leg as a result of her injuries and that doctors were working to save the other leg. A 43-year-old man was arrested following the attack, with counter-terrorism authorities among the multiple agencies involved in the investigation. Police are considering potential charges, including causing harm to a public official - an offence that carries a maximum penalty of 10 years' imprisonment - as they work to establish a motive for the attack. "At this stage it appears this is an isolated incident," Australian Federal Police Commissioner Krissy Barrett said. STRUCK TWO TIMES Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke told ABC Radio that witnesses said the alleged attacker reversed the vehicle and struck Haines a second time before a bystander intervened. Ricky Jefferies ran from his barber shop, restraining the attacker and removing a knife from him after initially believing the incident was a car accident, Australian media reported. "I heard a loud bang with no brakes. It was crazy, I just ran out to the front to see what's happening," Jefferies told reporters outside his shop. "I didn't realise the seriousness of the situation initially, and once it became relevant I just did what I could and what others were already trying to do." 'TURN TEMPERATURE DOWN' Violent attacks on politicians are extremely rare in Australia, where federal lawmakers, state leaders and even prime ministers are regularly seen in supermarkets and coffee shops, attending community events and chatting with voters with minimal security. [USN:L4N4650NF TEXT:"Haines"] worked in nursing and midwifery and as an academic before being elected to parliament as an independent in 2019 in the seat of Indi. She retained the seat in 2022 and 2025. Outside the hospital where Haines is being treated, Melbourne resident Shawn Hill said the attack showed that "the political climate is becoming more and more polarising today." "No one deserves to be put at risk of anything, especially someone who is serving the people and trying to do what is best for the Australian community," Hill told Reuters. Albanese urged Australians to engage more respectfully with one another, expressing concern about growing division in the country. He also noted a "significant increase" in threats against politicians in recent years. "We all have a responsibility to turn the temperature down," Albanese said. "I really don't want to see the character of Australia change."

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（19日）ユーロ下落、ナスダック1％超高 利回り上昇
item.description: ＜為替＞ ユーロが対ドルで下落した。フランスでの暴動が同国の財政見通し悪化への懸念を一段と強めた。一方、ドルは人工知能（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（19日）ユーロ下落、ナスダック1％超高　利回り上昇 7:07 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）前のウォール街の標識。2021年7月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

＜為替＞ ユーロが対ドルで下落した。フランスでの暴動が同国の財政見通し悪化への懸念を一段と強めた。一方、ドルは人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の反発を受けて上昇した。

フランスでは、政府が財政赤字の縮小を図る中、政府に対する全国的な抗議デモが週末に暴動と略奪に発展。これを受け、フランス当局は１９日、首都パリや北部リール、南部ニースなど複数の都市の一部地域に夜間外出禁止令を発令した。

今回の暴動は、極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏が来年の大統領選で勝利する可能性を高めるとも見られており、フランスのＥＵ残留を巡って疑問が浮上する恐れがある。

ユーロは０．２４％安の１．１２１２ドル。独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４７ｂｐに拡大し、２０１１─１２年の欧州債務危機以来の水準で取引された。

ドルは、ＡＩ関連株が先週の急落から反発したことを受けて上昇した。先週は、ＡＩ株に対する熱狂の後退が資本流入を細らせ、ドル需要を減退させるとの懸念からドルが押し下げられていた。

円は対ドルで０．３５％下落し、１ドル＝１５８．４９円。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが上昇した。ＡＩ（人工知能）関連株に高金利が及ぼす影響に対する懸念が和らいだことを背景に、安全資産への資金流入の動きが一服した。

先週はＡＩ関連インフラ銘柄への投資が鈍化する可能性があるとの懸念から株式市場で大幅な売りが出たことで、安全資産とされる米国債への需要が高まり、指標１０年債利回りは先週、１４．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下。ただ、この日は株式市場でＡＩ関連株が持ち直し、ハイテク関連銘柄が多いナスダック総合指数は１％超上昇した。

終盤の取引で、１０年債利回りは４．２ｂｐ上昇の５．１４％。３０年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇の５．４７７％。

２年債利回りは２．５ｂｐ上昇の４．７６１％。２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３７．５ｂｐ。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が１％超上昇した。先週大幅下落した半導体やその他の人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株に買いが戻った。投資家は主要企業の決算発表を待っている。

交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）大手メタ・プラットフォームズは０．５％安で終了した。同社は電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラとともに２１日に決算を発表する予定。スペースＸは２０日に発表する。

ダウ工業株３０種は小幅に下落、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は小幅に上昇した。

ただ、相場の上昇は指数への影響が大きい大型株に強く依存した。また、主要指数は取引時間中にこの日の高値から水準を切り下げた。原油価格の変動に伴い、エネルギー市場からの支援材料が一部失われたことが一因だった。

クラウドコンピューティング企業コアウィーブは、５００億ドルの債務負担への懸念から先週２５％超急落し、売りの中心となっていた。この日はゴールドマン・サックスによる投資判断の「ニュートラル」から「バイ」への引き上げに反応したとみられる序盤の上昇を維持できず、０．４％安で取引を終えた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の政策決定を控え、ドル高と米長期金利の上昇が重しとなり、金相場は下落した。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比０．５％安の１オンス＝４１６０．１０ドル。現物価格も０．４％安の４１４７．８７ドルとなった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ イランが支援するイエメンの親イラン武装組織「フーシ」によるイエメン軍訓練キャンプへの攻撃や、サウジアラビアのエネルギー、空港、軍事施設への攻撃再開を受け、まちまちの展開となった。米ＷＴＩ先物の清算値は、前日比２．２５ドル（２．２％）高の１バレル＝１０３．６６ドルと、９月１５日以来の高値を付けた。一方、北海ブレント先物は０．３１ドル（０．３％）安の１０９．５５ドルで清算。前週に５カ月ぶり高値まで上昇した反動から利益確定売りが先行し、取引序盤には３ドル超下落する場面もあった。

ＷＴＩは１０月２０日の期近限月の期限切れを前に、商いが低調だった。取引は流動性の高い１２月物に集中し、売買高は１９万５０００枚超に達した。期限切れを控えた１１月物の売買高は約２万６０００枚にとどまった。１２月物の清算値は０．５％安の９８．５４ドルだった。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: UniCredit to buy back securities-services unit from Societe Generale, document shows
item.description: Italy's second-biggest bank, UniCredit , has signed an agreement to repurchase its securities-services business from French peer Societe Generale , according to a union document seen by Reuters on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italy's second-biggest bank, UniCredit (CRDI.MI) , has signed an agreement to repurchase its securities-services business from French peer Societe Generale (SOGN.PA) , according to a union document seen by Reuters on Monday. The unit, which looks after investors' securities and handles related administrative services, has 54 staff in Milan and Turin, according to the document, which did not provide any financial details of the agreement. Societe Generale bought UniCredit's securities services unit in 2006, striking a long-term partnership to handle those services for the Italian bank. The supply contract was last renewed in 2017 until 2026. UniCredit is seeking to bring in-house activities it deems strategic, and the transaction is part of that effort, the document said. Handling the securities itself will reduce the need for an external supplier and improve use of the business' data, UniCredit and Societe Generale did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

item.title: National Australia Bank to cut 2,500 jobs in cost overhaul as credit growth slows
item.description: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it will shed up to 2,500 jobs, or about 6% of its workforce, in the next year to simplify its operations and cut costs while the nation's credit growth remains under pressure.
item.dc:creator: Scott Murdoch, Rajasik Mukherjee
item.content:encoded: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB.AX) said on Tuesday it will shed up to 2,500 jobs, or about 6% of its workforce, in the next year to simplify its operations and cut costs while the nation's credit growth remains under pressure. The bank, which is Australia's biggest business lender and third-largest home lender, said up to 1,500 roles would go by the end of 2026. The biggest cuts will target corporate roles rather than customer-facing bankers, it said. It also plans to materially reduce its use of consultants and contractors. "Our ambition and strategy remain unchanged. We will improve productivity, risk outcomes and execution to be a simpler and more efficient bank," Chief Executive Andrew Irvine said in a statement. NAB stock was down nearly 2.5% on Tuesday, and recorded the largest share price decline of Australia's "Big Four" retail banks in the session. The S&P/ASX 200 (.AXJO) was down 0.9%. NAB said it would begin consultation with the Finance Sector Union, whose national assistant secretary Nicole McPherson said the job cuts would not help simplify the organisation. "To take a wrecking ball to 6% of one of Australia's largest workforces this close to Christmas is disgraceful and shows that NAB's leadership is completely detached from the lived experience of their workers," she said. The overhaul will result in a restructuring charge of about A$300 million ($209 million) before tax in 2027, related to redundancy, redeployment and organisational redesign costs. The charge compares with about A$80 million before tax incurred in each of 2025 and 2026, NAB said. The job cuts follow a period of mounting pressure on Australia's banks as weaker housing activity, rising competition and higher operating costs weigh on earnings. [USN:L1N44D060 TEXT:"In August"], NAB warned that housing credit growth would slow sharply in 2027 following the [USN:L4N42409E TEXT:"federal government's property tax"] reforms, which the bank said had dampened demand from homebuyers and investors. At that time, Irvine said the combined effects of geopolitical uncertainty, higher domestic interest rates and tax changes were creating challenges for customers. NAB employed 41,880 people globally as of September 30, 2025, according to its latest annual report. The move follows a similar restructuring drive at rival ANZ (ANZ.AX) , which last year announced plans to cut about [USN:L3N3UV1F1 TEXT:"3,500 jobs"] by September 2026 as part of a simplification program under CEO Nuno Matos to reduce duplication and lower costs. ($1 = 1.4329 Australian dollars)

item.title: Trading Day: AI storm abates
item.description: Wall Street recovered some ground on Monday as investors bought back beaten-down tech stocks and looked forward to key earnings reports, while easing worries over AI also cooled last week's safe-haven demand for bonds and pushed yields higher. Unrest and riots in France, meanwhile, weighed heavily on French bond prices and pushed the euro lower.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded:
[USN:L6N4650KA TEXT:"Wall Street"] recovered some ground on Monday as investors bought back beaten-down [USN:L4N4650VO TEXT:"tech stocks"] and looked forward to key earnings reports, while easing worries over AI also cooled last week's safe-haven demand for bonds and pushed yields higher. Unrest and riots in [USN:L1N4650EF TEXT:"France"], meanwhile, weighed heavily on French bond prices and pushed the euro lower. In [USN:L6N4620ZO TEXT:"my column today"], I look at AI's pivotal role in exacerbating global imbalances and driving global capital flows. The two are increasingly connected. If investor sentiment towards AI sours — and there are signs this may be happening — then the unwind could get messy. Today's Key Reads [USN:FWN4630KA TEXT:"France imposes curfews in parts of Paris, other cities after weekend of riots "] [USN:L1N46501H TEXT:"China's economic growth picks up as exports boom, consumers balk "] [USN:P8N42J00P TEXT:"China's central bank studies making overnight rate its main policy rate"] [USN:L4N45Z033 TEXT:"Global food inflation is expected to intensify as supply shocks pile up "] [USN:SPN46100U TEXT:"Ex-OpenAI employee accused of planting device appears to have Saudi backing, US prosecutors say"] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Asia mostly higher, [USN:L4N464006 TEXT:"Indonesia "]-3.5%. [USN:L6N4650GG TEXT:"Europe"], [USN:L6N4650M4 TEXT:"UK "]slide around 1%. France -1%, although Italy and Spain fall more. Nasdaq +1.1%, S&P 500 +0.4%, Dow flat. SECTORS/SHARES: Four sectors on the S&P 500 rise, seven fall. Tech +1.2%, consumer cyclicals +2.7%. Utilities -2%. Western Digital +6%, Amazon +5%. JPMorgan Chase -2%. FX: Dollar rises vs most G10 except Aussie, [USN:L6N4650XD TEXT:"Canadian "]dollars. China's yuan hits four-year high vs dollar. BONDS: [USN:L6N4650CW TEXT:"French"] yields, spreads leap. US yields up around 3-4 bps across the curve. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L4N464059 TEXT:"Oil"] mixed — Brent -0.5%, WTI +2%.

Today's Talking Points: Political risk sizzles [USN:L8N46401O TEXT:"France"], [USN:S8N442025 TEXT:"Brazil"], [USN:L1N4600TJ TEXT:"the US "]— just a few of the countries where polarized politics and looming elections are becoming increasingly important risk factors for investors to consider. France isn't the only country in Europe — or the world — facing unenviable fiscal challenges, but the riots spreading across the country are unlikely to make meeting them any easier. Brazilians go to the polls on Sunday in a closely contested runoff presidential election vote, and the US midterm elections barely two weeks away could see President Donald Trump's Republican Party lose control of both houses of Congress. Affordability, inflation, high energy prices, and worries over job security amid the AI revolution are issues dominating the national conversation in every country. Policymakers gathered in Bangkok for the IMF/World Bank meetings last week shared calls for fiscal discipline, AI vigilance, and tackling global trade imbalances. But that's easier said than done when domestic politics are so fractured everywhere, and the spirit of multilateralism is its lowest in decades. FXing a hole China's economy grew by 4.5% in the third quarter, official figures on Monday showed. The good news — that was faster than economists had expected; the not so good news — it was driven by roaring exports, which are putting the country on course to top last year's record $1.2 trillion trade surplus. China's bulging surplus is a key contributor to the expanding global imbalances that the IMF and others are warning about. Perhaps the rising yuan will help wean the economy off exports and support domestic demand. The yuan has been appreciating steadily for the last 18 months, and is now at a 4-year high against the dollar. But the yuan's broader 'real effective exchange rate,' or REER, is still on the weak side. Yes, its REER value has risen 7% since May last year, but it's also around 15% weaker than it was four years ago and right now is right on its average of the past 20 years. AI boomerang After last week's selloff, the global AI trade got off to a stronger start this week. At least, with tech earnings about to begin rolling out, sentiment in the US improved — the 'SOX' semiconductor index on Monday snapped an eight-day losing streak, its worst run since October 2008. The 2.5% rise on Monday is a good start, but there's more to go if last week's 11.5% slump is to be clawed back. Similarly, South Korea's KOSPI's 4% rebound in the last two trading sessions will be welcomed, but the index is still down around 20% from where it was two weeks ago. Like politics mentioned above, AI sentiment is becoming increasingly polarized. Few people doubt the technology's transformative significance, but bulls and bears are digging in for the long haul. All eyes are now on US earnings, and whether the incoming numbers and company outlooks justify the (still) lofty stock prices. What could move markets tomorrow? item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy says US decisions on Ukraine hard to explain
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Monday that decisions taken by the United States on the war in Ukraine, including delays in arms shipments and restrictions on intelligence sharing, were "hard to explain."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Monday that decisions taken by the United States on the war in Ukraine, including delays in arms shipments and restrictions on intelligence sharing, were "hard to explain." "Because it all comes down to (Russian President Vladimir) Putin's refusal to end this war , and to decisions on the American side that are hard to explain between friends," Zelenskiy said in a meeting with a US congressional delegation. Zelenskiy said Ukraine had not received full explanations over limitations placed on the use of the Starshield system needed to stage some drone strikes and defend against Russian attacks, particularly by high-speed jet-powered drones. In remarks posted on a video on Telegram, he said that on three occasions in the past week, Ukraine had not received the advance warning of an attack generally provided by its partners. "We also know that, unfortunately, the Pentagon is delaying the delivery of missiles that our partner have already paid for through the PURL programme," he said. He said that to his knowledge one missile package was waiting for signature by US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. "All of this suggests that some political decision has been made to slow down support for us," he said. Zelenskiy also said that Ukraine was willing to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries, as demanded by US President Donald Trump , for 30 days if Washington supplied Ukraine with interceptors for the Patriot anti-missile system. He also said that he hoped a Ukrainian delegation would meet in the coming days with US presidential envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Norway.

item.title: Japan launches mission to return samples from Mars moon
item.description: Japan launched an uncrewed spacecraft toward the Martian moon Phobos on Tuesday on a mission intended to become the first to collect samples from the small rocky body and return them to Earth for analysis.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan launched an uncrewed spacecraft toward the Martian moon Phobos on Tuesday on a mission intended to become the first to collect samples from the small rocky body and return them to Earth for analysis. The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency's Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft lifted off aboard an H3 rocket before dawn from the Tanegashima Space Center in southwestern Japan. The spacecraft is expected to reach Mars in August 2027 and return samples to Earth in 2031. JAXA hopes the mission will shed light on the origin of the two moons of Mars and deepen the understanding of our solar system's early stages. Phobos, the larger of the two Martian moons, orbits the planet three times a day. Phobos has an irregular shape with dimensions of about 27 km by 22 km by 18 km (17 miles by 14 miles by 11 miles), and orbits roughly 6,000 km (3,700 miles) above the Martian surface. JAXA aims to collect at least 10 grammes of material from its surface and return it to Earth for analysis. The launch marked the first interplanetary mission for Japan's H3 rocket. The country's flagship launcher experienced a high-profile failure on its inaugural flight in 2023 when its second-stage engine failed to ignite, but has since completed a series of mostly successful launches.

item.title: 米国株式市場＝ナスダック1％超高、半導体・ＡＩ株に買い戻し
item.description:
Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
［１９日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は、ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ナスダック1％超高、半導体・ＡＩ株に買い戻し 5:12 配信

2026年10月8日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）　 REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

Tharuniyaa Lakshmi

［１９日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は、ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が１％超上昇した。先週大幅下落した半導体やその他の人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株に買いが戻った。投資家は主要企業の決算発表を待っている。

１６日までの週は、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が６月下旬以来の大幅な週間下落を記録した。金利上昇がＡＩインフラへの投資を抑制するとの懸念が、半導体企業やデータセンター運営会社を中心にハイテク株の重荷となってきた。

売りの背景には、多額の費用がかかるＡＩ開発の資金をどう調達するかを巡る投資家の不安の高まりがあった。この問題は、最近４周年を迎えた米国株の強気相場を支えてきた企業への圧力を強めている。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は１．６％高で引け、９営業日ぶりに反発した。それまでの８営業日で約１５．７％下落し、２００８年１０月以来の長期連続下落を記録していた。

ローゼンブラット・セキュリティーズのマネジングディレクター兼株式セールストレーダー、マイケル・ジェームズ氏は「ゴムひもは一方向に伸ばし続けても限界があり、やがて反動で逆方向に動き始める。１６日の取引終了後、半導体株ではようやく『もう十分だ』という転換点が訪れた」と指摘。

「１６日の引けから今朝の寄り付きまで、週末に悪材料が出なかったこと以外に何も変わっていない。投資家心理が極端に悪化し、反発してもおかしくないほど売られ過ぎていた」と語った。

その上で、今後数日から数週間に多くのハイテク企業の決算発表が予定されており、市場は「危機を脱したとは到底言えない」と警告した。

交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）大手メタ・プラットフォームズは０．５％安で終了した。同社は電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラとともに２１日に決算を発表する予定。スペースＸは２０日に発表する。

ダウ工業株３０種は小幅に下落、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は小幅に上昇した。

ただ、相場の上昇は指数への影響が大きい大型株に強く依存した。また、主要指数は取引時間中にこの日の高値から水準を切り下げた。原油価格の変動に伴い、エネルギー市場からの支援材料が一部失われたことが一因だった。

米原油先物は序盤の下落から切り返し、２．２％高の１バレル＝１０３．６６ドルで清算した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がイエメンの軍事訓練施設を攻撃したほか、サウジアラビアのエネルギー施設や空港、軍事施設への攻撃を再開したことを受けた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち７業種が下落した。一般消費財が２．７％高と上昇率首位で、情報技術が１．２％高と続いた。一方、ディフェンシブ業種の公益事業が２％安、不動産が１．２％安と、下落率が大きかった。

一般消費財を大きく押し上げたのはアマゾン・ドット・コムなどだった。モルガン・スタンレーが電子商取引とクラウドコンピューティングを手がける同社を「最有力推奨銘柄」に選定し、株価は５％高で終了した。テスラは３．８％上昇し、同業種指数への押し上げ寄与度が２番目に大きかった。

クラウドコンピューティング企業コアウィーブは、５００億ドルの債務負担への懸念から先週２５％超急落し、売りの中心となっていた。この日はゴールドマン・サックスによる投資判断の「ニュートラル」から「バイ」への引き上げに反応したとみられる序盤の上昇を維持できず、０．４％安で取引を終えた。

同業のネビウスは２．９％高、アイレンは２．７％高と、コアウィーブを上回る値動きとなった。インテルはＪＰモルガンが投資判断を「アンダーウエート」から「ニュートラル」に引き上げたことを受け、２．４％上昇した。

鉄鋼メーカーのクリーブランド・クリフスは、第３・四半期利益がアナリスト予想を上回り、１６％急伸した。

この日は、ダウ工業株３０種が１日の下落率として過去最大を記録した１９８７年の株価暴落「ブラックマンデー」から３９年に当たる。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では、値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．６９対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．１７対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５２億７０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億６０００万株。

Speaking alongside Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at a red-c

FAST

BERLIN/FRANKFURT, Oct 19 : Chancellor Friedrich Merz appealed to Germany's businesses to embrace artificial intelligence at an industry summit in Berlin on Monday that was meant to attract investment, including an expected deal with US chip maker Nvidia.  Speaking alongside Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at a red-carpet event marking the start of the summit, Merz stressed the importance of AI in efforts to revive Germany's economy and modernise its industry.  Faced with global competition that is targeting the country's top auto, chemicals and engineering firms, Merz is under pressure to secure growth amid rising support for the far-right Alternative for Deutschland party.  "We are in the midst of a fundamental economic and technological transformation fuelled by exponential progress in artificial intelligence," Merz said, telling business leaders: "Please open your doors for AI to make use of your data."

Merz said cooperation with Nvidia was key for Germany's future success. Huang pointed to the company's existing cooperation with German carmakers like Mercedes-Benz, which is developing premium robotaxis using Nvidia software. Germany and Nvidia are expected to announce a partnership to promote AI in German industry at the summit, which continues on Tuesday. The German economy ministry has signed a memorandum of understanding with Nvidia, the government said, without giving further details. Huang also announced planned investments in German startups Agile Robots, Avelios Medical, Mirelo and Reflex Aerospace, Nvidia said in a blog post Monday. The investments are part of Nvidia's nearly $10 billion commitment to the technology ecosystem across Europe, it said. A German group of companies and investors that includes Siemens and Deutsche Bank said in a report that it sees the potential for investment of up to €4.1 trillion ($4.6 trillion) in Germany by 2035 across areas including AI, energy and defence. Made for Germany, a private sector business group, said its members planned to invest more than €850 billion through 2028, after investing more than €200 billion in 2025. More companies and investors have been invited to join the initiative. ($1 = €0.8926)

item.title: Trump open to idea of joint meeting with Xi, Putin next month
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Monday he is open to three-way arms-control talks with the leaders of China and Russia as soon as next month, raising the prospect of an unprecedented meeting and a major diplomatic gambit for the US president.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Ryan Patrick Jones
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Monday he is open to three-way arms-control talks with the leaders of China and Russia as soon as next month, raising the prospect of an unprecedented meeting and a major diplomatic gambit for the US president. "We would have it to talk about nuclear weapons and denuclearization," Trump told reporters outside the White House. "If President Xi wants to have it, I'd have it. I'm sure we'd talk about other things like trade too." Trump has tried to thaw frosty relations with Beijing and Moscow as those non-Western powers grow closer. A three-way meeting would also raise alarm from Europe to Asia over private deals that weaken Washington's transatlantic and Indo-Pacific alliances. But a deal struck between the three countries could also lower global tensions. An end to Russia's war in Ukraine could resolve the biggest threat in decades to European security, and a deal on arms would bind the three nations with the biggest stockpiles of nuclear weapons. In recent days, Trump has moved to warm ties with Russian President Vladimir Putin, announcing a diesel-fuel deal and signing an order on Friday waiving key sanctions on Moscow. Trump has also sought stable relations with Chinese President Xi Jinping, who in turn has nurtured close ties with Putin. So far, Trump has not delivered on a campaign promise to quickly end the war in Ukraine. The White House has been discussing for weeks a possible meeting between the leaders focused on denuclearization on the sidelines of the November 18-19 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China, according to a person familiar with the matter. Putin later pitched using such a meeting to negotiate an end to the four-year-old Ukraine conflict in a manner that would favor Moscow, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the discussions. Putin's suggestion came during an October 9 phone call with Trump that yielded the deal on Russian diesel. Earlier on Monday, the Kremlin said that the potential meeting had come up in talks. The three leaders have met separately but never held formal talks together. The White House did not respond to a Reuters request for comment. The Russian and Chinese embassies in Washington also did not reply to requests for comment. Trump's diesel deal with Putin and the executive order waiving sanctions on Moscow have drawn criticism from Ukrainian President Volodymyr [USN:L6N46517L TEXT:"Zelenskiy"], who has warned they would [USN:L1N4650WT TEXT:"embolden Putin"] and prolong the war. Speaking about the possible meeting on Monday, Trump said, "I would do it, not so much for Ukraine because Russia, frankly, has been fine on Ukraine." He added that "Zelenskiy is not helping matters much," and that "it's time for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine." Moscow launched one of its [USN:L1N46500P TEXT:"broadest air assaults in months"] overnight, cutting power to more than half a million households and damaging energy infrastructure across Ukraine. Ten people were reported killed. TRUMP SEEKS NUCLEAR TALKS Last week, Trump told reporters he thought a denuclearization deal with Russia and China was possible, but that it "doesn't have to be this year." It's not clear how advanced any talks between the countries are. Russia has the most stored nuclear warheads, followed by the United States and China, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute. The Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty [USN:FWN3Z10T1 TEXT:"expired"] earlier this year. The New START treaty, signed in 2010, allowed a single extension, which Putin and former US President Joe Biden agreed to for five years. Any new extension would require an executive decision to voluntarily extend the limits of the treaty. China's foreign ministry said last week that its "nuclear strength is by no means at the same level with that of the US and Russia" and that it would be "neither fair, reasonable nor realistic to ask China to join the so-called trilateral nuclear disarmament negotiations at this stage." Trump has already agreed to attend the APEC summit in Shenzhen next month, marking his second trip to China this year and his third visit with Xi over the same period. China, Russia and the United States are all members of APEC. On Monday, Trump downplayed the idea of another high-profile meeting in China, with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. "I get along with him very well, and I'm not sure that anybody's asking for a meeting," he said. Trump previously said he [USN:S0N41X02R TEXT:"planned to meet"] with Kim this year. North Korea has publicly indicated that it is not open to talks aimed at convincing Pyongyang to give up its nuclear weapons.

Oct 19 : Nscale is in talks to sell AI computing power to Claude maker Anthropic in a new deal that could be worth about $45 billion, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday. The data center developer is seeking another major deal with the AI lab for a second facility at its Monarch data center campus in West Virginia, the person said. In August, Anthropic struck a deal to spend $45 billion to rent AI cloud computing power from Nscale's West Virginia data center campus. A second Monarch building would deliver 460 megawatts of computing power using Nvidia's advanced Vera Rubin AI chips, according to the source. Anthropic did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

Anthropic also has the right of first refusal on Monarch's expected third building, the person said, adding discussions were ongoing and details of the plan could change. Bloomberg, which first reported the news, also said a cohort of investors had urged Anthropic to lower its IPO valuation target after a series of market setbacks for AI companies. Investors have sharpened scrutiny of companies that are increasingly turning to debt-driven AI infrastructure expansion. Last week, Nscale rival CoreWeave's shares slumped amid concerns over its $50 billion debt load, fueling a global selloff in AI stocks. The news of a potential tie-up comes after Microsoft pulled out of a deal to anchor a flagship data center for Nscale following power connection delays that pushed its expected supply date into the 2030s. Nscale has grown rapidly since launch, increasing its total contracted value from $100 million to more than $103 billion in two-and-a-half years and competing with Nebius, Crusoe and Lambda. According to the Nscale prospectus, Microsoft and Anthropic are expected to be the company's major customers in the future.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ下落、仏財政懸念で ドルはＡＩ株反発で上昇
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。フランスでの暴動が同...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ下落、仏財政懸念で　ドルはＡＩ株反発で上昇 4:35 配信

2026年10月19日、フランス・パリで撮影。REUTERS/Abdul Saboor

［ニューヨーク　１９日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。フランスでの暴動が同国の財政見通し悪化への懸念を一段と強めた。一方、ドルは人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の反発を受けて上昇した。

フランスでは、政府が財政赤字の縮小を図る中、政府に対する全国的な抗議デモが週末に暴動と略奪に発展。これを受け、フランス当局は１９日、首都パリや北部リール、南部ニースなど複数の都市の一部地域に夜間外出禁止令を発令した。

今回の暴動は、極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏が来年の大統領選で勝利する可能性を高めるとも見られており、フランスのＥＵ残留を巡って疑問が浮上する恐れがある。

ユーロは０．２４％安の１．１２１２ドル。独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４７ｂｐに拡大し、２０１１─１２年の欧州債務危機以来の水準で取引された。

主要通貨バスケットに対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１７％高の１０１．９７。

ドルは、ＡＩ関連株が先週の急落から反発したことを受けて上昇した。先週は、ＡＩ株に対する熱狂の後退が資本流入を細らせ、ドル需要を減退させるとの懸念からドルが押し下げられていた。

カナダドルは対米ドルで０．２７％高の１米ドル＝１．４１カナダドル。カナダ銀行（中銀）のマックレム総裁が１７日に示したタカ派的な発言が通貨を下支えした。

産油州であるアルバータ州では１９日、同州がカナダから分離独立すべきかどうかを問う住民投票が実施される。

円は対ドルで０．３５％下落し、１ドル＝１５８．４９円。

Famous Siberian cave yields remains of yak-like Ice Age mammal

A yak grazes on a grass patch some 3,000 metres (9,842 feet) above sea level in the mountains outside Almaty November 1, 2009. REUTERS/Shamil Zhumatov/File Photo

20 Oct 2026 02:52AM (Updated: 20 Oct 2026 02:54AM)

FAST

Oct 19 : A Siberian cave already famous for yielding the first remains of an extinct human lineage called the Denisovans, who once roamed widely in Eurasia, has now produced evidence of a previously unknown large Ice Age mammal closely related to today's yak. Researchers said they discovered small bone fragments of the animal in Denisova Cave in the Altai Mountains of southern Siberia in Russia, and obtained DNA that showed these remains belonged to a bovine species distinct from others already known, living and extinct. In all, the researchers studied 20 bone fragments from this species — 14 from Denisova Cave and 6 from other sites in the broader region. The oldest specimen dated to about 250,000 to 200,000 years ago, and the youngest to about 27,000 years ago. The bones themselves were so fragmentary that their shape alone did not reveal that they belonged to a previously unknown large mammal. But the researchers were able to generate 20 ancient genomes from the bones, and these showed that this was a unique species whose evolutionary lineage diverged from the ancestors of the modern-day yak approximately 400,000 years ago.

"It is unusual, especially to recognize a large mammal species from small, unidentifiable fragments," said evolutionary geneticist Love Dalén of the Centre for Palaeogenetics, a collaboration between Stockholm University and the Swedish Museum of Natural History, senior author of the research published in the journal Current Biology. "I'd say that this is related to the advances in the field of ancient DNA, as genetics is a powerful new layer of information applied to ancient materials," said Alexandre Gilardet, a doctoral student at the Centre for Palaeogenetics and co-lead author of the study, along with Centre for Palaeogenetics postdoctoral researcher Jonas Oppenheimer. Genetic evidence alone is not sufficient to allow for giving a scientific name to a new species, so the researchers are calling this one "Yak X." THE ICE AGE LANDSCAPE Dalén said Yak X lived alongside other bovines including steppe bison and the aurochs, the extinct wild ancestor of today's domesticated cattle. It also shared the Ice Age landscape with woolly mammoths, woolly rhinoceroses, horses and large predators such as cave hyenas and brown bears, Dalén said. "I'd expect it to have looked more like a yak than a bison, given its close relationship to modern yaks," Dalén said. Yaks are sturdily built animals with horns, long fur and a hump at the shoulders, looking a bit like a hairy ox. The largest males can weigh as much as a ton. Wild yaks are restricted to higher elevations of the Tibetan Plateau. The Yak X discovery deepens the understanding of the diversity of large Ice Age mammals and adds another species to the long list that disappeared at around the end of that epoch. "Using the long, 200,000-year time span of our sampling, we can see that the species may have undergone a population decline during a period of warming around 120,000 years ago, and went extinct some time after our youngest sample, about 27,000 years ago," Oppenheimer said. The vast Siberian expanse was a grassland ecosystem called the mammoth steppe, known as such for its largest denizens. Most of the region was left uncovered by the immense ice sheets that had blanketed large swathes of North America and Europe. The Yak X lineage diverged from the ancestors of modern yaks around the same time as the evolutionary split that occurred between the ursine lineages that led to today's brown bears and polar bears. THE DENISOVANS It was in Denisova Cave in 2008 that scientists unearthed a finger bone that offered the first evidence of the existence of Denisovans, extinct cousins of Neanderthals and our own species, Homo sapiens. Since then, more remains of Denisovans have been discovered in the cave and in several far-flung parts of Asia. Some modern populations of people, especially those in Melanesia and Papua New Guinea, carry a small percentage of DNA from Denisovans, indicating interbreeding with Homo sapiens before the Denisovans became extinct under circumstances that are not well understood. Denisovans were hunter-gatherers who survived in many different types of environments. The Yak X species might have been among the prey that they hunted. "It seems reasonable that Yak X was on the Denisovan menu," Dalén said.

Source: Reuters

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（19日） 3:50 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。銀行や鉱業株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は４営業日ぶりに反落した。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．６３％安と、７営業日ぶりの反落。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は２．３３％安。銀行大手のバークレイズは３．５％下落。プライベートクレジット融資に関する流動性などのリスクを過小評価するような不適切な表示をした疑いでイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が調査していると伝わった。

鉱業株指数は２．６５％安。銅価格の値下がりを受けて、資源大手アングロ・アメリカンは４．１％、グレンコアは３．３％、それぞれ下落した。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．３７％、公益事業株指数は２．１３％、それぞれ値下がりした。通期生産見通しを引き下げた石油・ガス会社セリカ・エナジーは２．０％下落した。

ヒーリー英財務相による初の予算案公表を来週に控える中、今週は消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）や小売売上高といった英経済指標が発表される。多くの企業決算も開示される予定となっている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

４営業日ぶりに反落して取引を終えた。２０２７年に大統領選を控えるフランスで、物価高や公共サービスの悪化に抗議するデモが拡大し、政局が混迷しつつある。財政を巡る懸念も相場の重荷となり、フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は１．１１％下落した。このほか、総選挙を１１月に控えて政治的な不透明感が強まったスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数も１．４９％安だった。

フランスの金融機関ＢＮＰパリバ、クレディ・アグリコル、ソシエテ・ジェネラルは２．５─３．４％下落。フランスの小売大手カルフールは２．２％、ショッピングセンターなどを手がけるウニベイル・ロダムコ・ウエストフィールドは２．１％それぞれ値下がりした。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は２．０７％下落。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．４３％安。

一方、テクノロジー株指数は０．７０％上昇。

今週は、ドイツのソフトウエア大手ＳＡＰ、フィンランドの通信機器大手ノキア、英銀大手のバークレイズの決算発表が予定されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

フランス国債利回りが上昇した。週末にフランス全土で抗議活動が繰り広げられたことを受け、巨額の財政赤字削減が同国政府にとっていかに困難かが浮き彫りとなった。

フランスでは１７日、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、同国で過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展。商業・小売連盟によると、週末に被害を受けた店舗は約３０００店に上っている。

投資家は、フランスが財政を立て直すには予算案を可決する必要があると指摘しているが、今回の抗議デモはそれがいかに難しいかを示している。来年の大統領選を控えた政治的な駆け引きが、事態をさらに複雑にする可能性もある。

ＳＭＢＣのグローバル市場ストラテジスト、ハンク・カレンティ氏は、財政赤字削減や年金改革の取り組みに言及し「抗議デモが繰り広げられた週末を経てこうした動きになったことは、改革への期待が後退していることを示している」と述べた。

フランス１０年債利回りは１３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９％と、１日としては９月下旬以来の上昇幅となる見通しとなった。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇の３．４５％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４６ｂｐと、２週間ぶりの高水準となった。それでも、１０月序盤に付けた１６０ｂｐ近辺からは縮小している。

イタリア１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ上昇の４．５８％。

item.title: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil asks US Supreme Court to hear case seeking to avoid re-arrest
item.description: Columbia University graduate Mahmoud Khalil on Monday asked the US Supreme Court to overturn a ruling that opened the door for President Donald Trump's administration to re-arrest and deport the Palestinian activist.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond, Jonathan Allen
item.content:encoded: Columbia University graduate [USN:L1N3SG0OI TEXT:"Mahmoud Khalil"] on Monday asked the US Supreme Court to overturn a ruling that opened the door for President Donald Trump's administration to re-arrest and deport the Palestinian activist. Khalil's lawyers asked the justices to take up his case after the Philadelphia-based 3rd US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that federal immigration law barred a lower-court judge from ordering his release from US Immigration and Customs Enforcement custody. Khalil was among the most prominent foreign students to be arrested last year as the Trump administration pursued a campaign to detain and deport noncitizens who engaged in pro-Palestinian activism on college campuses. His lawyers say the Supreme Court should make clear immigration law does not prevent noncitizens from pursuing cases arguing they have been detained to punish them for speech that is protected by the US Constitution's First Amendment. "If the Trump administration can punish someone for their pro-Palestine speech, this or any future administration can punish anyone for any speech," Khalil told reporters on Monday. If the 3rd Circuit's decision is allowed to stand, Khalil faces the prospect of arrest and deportation, after the Board of Immigration Appeals in April rejected his challenge to an immigration judge's order that he be removed to Algeria or Syria. A lower court order barring him from being re-detained remains in place for now until the Supreme Court rules. A separate appeal of the immigration judge's order remains pending. A spokesperson for the US Department of Homeland Security, which oversees ICE, in a statement said the Trump administration acted within its authority in Khalil's case, and it encouraged him to self-deport. KHALIL'S BACKGROUND AND ARREST Khalil, a prominent figure in pro-Palestinian protests against Israel's war in Gaza , is an Algerian citizen who was born in a Palestinian refugee camp in Syria. Immigration agents arrested him in March 2025 in the lobby of his university residence in Manhattan despite his being a lawful permanent resident, or green-card holder. His wife and their 1-year-old son are both US citizens. Secretary of State Marco Rubio had invoked an obscure provision of the Immigration and Nationality Act to deem Khalil removable, citing his involvement in "antisemitic protests and disruptive activities" at Columbia in 2024 that the government said fostered a hostile environment for Jewish students. He was released from a Louisiana detention center in June 2025 after the New Jersey-based US District Judge Michael Farbiarz, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, ordered the Department of Homeland Security to release him. In January, a 2-1 panel of the 3rd Circuit overturned Farbiarz's decision, saying that under the Immigration and Nationality Act, Khalil's claims could not be addressed through a district court and instead could be raised in an appeal of a removal order from an immigration judge. After the full appeals court declined to reconsider the case, Khalil turned to the Supreme Court. Federal appeals courts are split on whether district judges may hear challenges like Khalil's or whether such claims must proceed first through immigration courts, which are not part of the federal judiciary but are instead run by the US Department of Justice. The Trump administration [USN:L1N45E0AE TEXT:"last month asked"] the Supreme Court to overturn a ruling in a similar case favoring Georgetown University scholar Badar Khan Suri, another pro-Palestinian advocate detained by ICE who was ordered released.

MUMBAI, Oct 19 : Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance said on Monday that Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, BlackRock and Fidelity were among investors who bid in the anchor book of its record $3.2 billion Jio Platforms IPO, which two sources said drew more than $25 billion in demand. The telecoms, cloud and AI group on Monday opened its record initial public offering to institutional investors who can bid for up to 30 per cent of the offering exclusively earmarked for them, before the issue opens for public subscription on Wednesday.  Jio Platforms allocated shares worth over 81 billion rupees ($853.31 million) to anchor investors, a company filing showed on Monday. State-run insurer Life Insurance Corporation, French lender BNP Paribas, JPMorgan, India's largest private-sector lender HDFC Bank were among the other institutions allotted shares in the IPO anchor book.

The bids drawn were over 30 times the quota reserved for anchor investors, a source told Reuters. Jio upended India's telecoms market in 2016 by offering free voice calls and cheap data and soon became the country's biggest mobile operator. It now has more than 500 million subscribers and competes with Bharti Airtel and Vodafone Idea. Its listing is seen as a test of what global investors will pay for that scale and for Jio's expansion into cloud and AI. Led by Mukesh Ambani's son Akash Ambani, Jio operates Reliance Industries' telecom and digital businesses, spanning mobile services, fixed broadband, cloud, entertainment, enterprise technology and AI offerings. Jio's IPO follows September's listing of the National Stock Exchange of India, underscoring investor appetite for large offerings in the Indian market. It will be the first offering by Reliance since its listing of Reliance Petroleum in 2006. Year-to-date Indian IPO proceeds rose 8.3 per cent to $12.65 billion compared with the same period last year, LSEG data shows. A successful IPO would place Jio Platforms among the top four Indian listed companies by market capitalisation, behind its parent Reliance, its rival Bharti Airtel and the country's largest private lender HDFC Bank. Jio plans to use up to 275 billion Indian rupees ($2.90 billion) of the net proceeds to repay or prepay borrowings of its telecom subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm. ($1 = 94.9475 Indian rupees)

item.title: Brazil's government says $4 billion budget reshuffle needed for Lula measures in 2027
item.description: Brazil's Planning Ministry said on Monday that the budget reallocations needed to accommodate measures recently announced by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva as he seeks re-election in next Sunday's vote amount to about 20 billion reais ($3.95 billion) in the 2027 budget.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's Planning Ministry said on Monday that the budget reallocations needed to accommodate measures recently announced by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva as he seeks re-election in next Sunday's vote amount to about 20 billion reais ($3.95 billion) in the 2027 budget. In a statement, the ministry said the amount represents just over 1% of total primary expenditure subject to spending limits under Brazil's fiscal framework, adding such adjustments will be made while preserving both the overall spending cap and the government's primary [USN:L1N44S10B TEXT:"budget target"]. Leftist Lula has unveiled a string of measures ahead of Sunday's runoff after [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"trailing"] right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in the first round Announcements [USN:L1N46114S TEXT:"range"] from free nationwide weekend public transport, which has yet to be formally submitted to Congress, to a 15% increase in the Bolsa Familia welfare program that is already being implemented The government said the Bolsa Familia increase alone would [USN:L1N4590JP TEXT:"cost"] 22 billion reais in 2027 The Planning Ministry did not explain how the budget reallocations required to fund the broader package of measures would amount to less than that The ministry said estimates circulating publicly about the total fiscal impact wrongly combine measures with different funding sources and implementation timelines, arguing some policies, such as fuel tax relief, have been offset by higher oil-related revenue It added that public policy implementation should not automatically be viewed as election-driven spending ($1 = 5.0612 reais)

item.title: Ronaldo handed 30-day ban for leaving Portugal camp following coach Jesus rift
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo was suspended for 30 days by the Portuguese FA on Monday after leaving the national team camp following a rift with coach Jorge Jesus over his role in the side.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cristiano Ronaldo was suspended for 30 days by the Portuguese FA on Monday after [USN:L6N45M14A TEXT:"leaving"] the national team camp following a [USN:L6N45M14A TEXT:"rift"] with coach Jorge Jesus over his role in the side. The federation's disciplinary council said it had upheld the charge against the 41-year-old forward in full and imposed a fine of 255 euros ($285.83). Ronaldo left Portugal's base in Copenhagen before their Nations League match against Denmark earlier this month, having accused Jesus of twice breaking his word about his role after he was an unused substitute against Norway. Jesus denied making any agreement with Ronaldo but left the door open for his return following Portugal's 2-1 win. The disciplinary council's non-professional section found Ronaldo had intentionally committed an offence under Article 160(1) of the federation's disciplinary regulations. Proceedings were opened on October 9 over facts reported two days earlier. The statement did not specify which matches or activities the suspension would cover, or whether time already served under a provisional suspension would count towards the 30-day sanction. Ronaldo later apologised for failing to acknowledge supporters after the Norway match and for leaving his teammates, saying he remained available for selection after serving any punishment arising from the incident. Portuguese FA president Pedro Proenca has said everyone within the federation wanted Ronaldo to return to the national team once the matter was resolved. ($1 = 0.8921 euros)

NEW YORK, Oct 19 : IT services company DXC Technology is in advanced talks to sell its insurance software and services division to private investment firm Eldridge Industries for about $2.4 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Eldridge is discussing combining the business with Zinnia, its insurance technology platform that provides software and digital infrastructure to life insurance and annuity providers, the sources said. An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, although there is no certainty a deal will be finalized, the people said, requesting anonymity because the discussions are confidential. DXC Technology, Eldridge and Zinnia did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
